```{r}
# Load all required libraries in one chunk for global availability
library(dplyr)

# Load data and process
data1 <- read_excel("C:/Users/75118/Desktop/OPUS data for machine learning/multiple linear regression BMD change/results/results only miRs/final datafile for machine learning_miR_ratio_norm_full data - LumbarBMD_change - PrevFx.xlsx")

# Remove unwanted columns and omit missing values
data <- data1[, -1, drop = FALSE]
data <- na.omit(data)

data

# Defdata# Define necessary column indices here
# All indices refer to the dataset AFTER removing the first column.

columns_omics <- 10       # First column containing candidate biomarkers
columns_nonomics <- 9    # Last column containing non-omics data

columns_categoric <- 2   # Categorical predictors; use integer(0) if none

columns_response <- 9    # Continuous response variable(s)
columns_predictors <- 1:8 # Mandatory predictors

# Define expanded design-matrix indices later, after factor conversion.
# This avoids assuming how many dummy columns categorical predictors create.
columns_predictors_x <- NULL


# Define response and predictor columns based on data
response_cols <- colnames(data)[columns_response]
predictor_cols_base <- colnames(data)[columns_predictors]


# Check that responses are numeric and continuous
for (response_col in response_cols) {

  if (!is.numeric(data[[response_col]])) {
    stop(
      "The response variable must be numeric for linear regression: ",
      response_col
    )
  }

  if (any(!is.finite(data[[response_col]]))) {
    stop(
      "The response variable contains non-finite values: ",
      response_col
    )
  }

  if (length(unique(data[[response_col]])) < 3) {
    stop(
      "The response variable is constant or binary; ",
      "a continuous outcome is expected: ",
      response_col
    )
  }
}


# No class balancing is required for a continuous outcome.
# Keep this function name for compatibility with subsequent chunks.
# It returns all training observations without undersampling.

balance_data <- function(df, response_col) {
  return(df)
}


# Equal observation weights for ordinary linear regression.
# No binary-class or outcome-frequency weighting is applied.

compute_case_weights <- function(df, response_col) {
  return(rep(1, nrow(df)))
}


# Use ordinary, unweighted linear regression.
# If subsequent code calls balance_data(), all training rows are retained.
use_weights <- FALSE



```

## For loop to individually select significant predictor biomarkers for the binomial response variables in logistic regression handling class imbalance with undersampling of the majority class

AUC baseline: Performance of the logistic (binomial or multinomial) regression model without the selected biomarkers, only with the main predictors
AUC biomakrer: Performance of the logistic (binomial or multinomial) regression model including the selected biomarker as a significant predictor of the response
ANOVA: ANOVA of baseline model vs model with biomarker

Weights Affect Model Likelihoods Differently: glm() with weights applies weighted maximum likelihood estimation, meaning the likelihood values it computes are different from an unweighted model. The anova() function expects models to be directly comparable, but weighted and unweighted models don't have likelihoods on the same scale. This makes the likelihood-ratio test invalid in some cases, leading to NA in p-values. That is why instead of comparing weighted vs. unweighted models, ensure both models, the baseline and the full model with biomarker, use weights. This makes sure anova() compares models estimated in the same way.


Removed for loop over response_cols as they is only one which was used for the splitting of the data into training and test sets, which we used at the beginning of the code for both our individual marker selection loop and our elastic net marker selection loop!!! 

```{r results='asis', warning=FALSE}


# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(writexl)
library(rsample)
library(DT)
library(ggplot2)


# Initialize lists to store the results
results_list <- list()
prediction_storage <- list()
predictor_results <- list()
failed_models <- list()


# Keep a stable row identifier for reusing the same splits later
data$row_id <- seq_len(nrow(data))


# Create directory for Excel files if it does not exist
dir.create(
  "Individually Selected Predictors",
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


##########################################################
############ Linear regression helper functions ##########
##########################################################

# Safely construct formulas, including nonstandard column names
make_linear_formula <- function(response, predictors) {

  variables <- c(response, predictors)

  if (any(grepl("`", variables, fixed = TRUE))) {
    stop("Please remove backtick characters from column names.")
  }

  quote_name <- function(x) {
    paste0("`", x, "`")
  }

  rhs <- if (length(predictors) > 0) {
    paste(quote_name(predictors), collapse = " + ")
  } else {
    "1"
  }

  as.formula(
    paste(
      quote_name(response),
      "~",
      rhs
    )
  )
}


# Predictive test-set metrics
calculate_regression_metrics <- function(actual, predicted) {

  predicted <- as.numeric(predicted)

  if (
    length(actual) != length(predicted) ||
    any(!is.finite(actual)) ||
    any(!is.finite(predicted))
  ) {
    stop("Observed outcomes and predictions must be finite and aligned.")
  }

  residuals <- actual - predicted

  sse <- sum(residuals^2)

  sst <- sum(
    (actual - mean(actual))^2
  )

  # Predictive R², not squared correlation.
  # Negative values are possible.
  test_r2 <- if (sst > 0) {
    1 - sse / sst
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  list(
    R2 = test_r2,
    RMSE = sqrt(mean(residuals^2)),
    MAE = mean(abs(residuals))
  )
}


# Shapiro-Wilk is defined only for 3–5000 observations
calculate_shapiro <- function(residuals) {

  if (
    length(residuals) < 3 ||
    length(residuals) > 5000 ||
    any(!is.finite(residuals)) ||
    sd(residuals) == 0
  ) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  tryCatch(
    shapiro.test(residuals)$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
}


# Safe summary functions for potentially undefined metrics
safe_mean <- function(x) {

  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  mean(x)
}


safe_median <- function(x) {

  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  median(x)
}


safe_sd <- function(x) {

  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  if (length(x) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  sd(x)
}


safe_quantile <- function(x, probability) {

  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  unname(
    quantile(
      x,
      probs = probability
    )
  )
}


##########################################################
######################## TODO ############################
##########################################################

###############################
##### Robustness threshold ####
###############################

n_seeds <- 50

min_frequency <- ceiling(0.80 * n_seeds)

# Preserve the thresholds from your logistic code
individual_p_threshold <- 0.10

predictor_p_threshold <- 0.05


##########################################################
############ Define response and biomarkers ##############
##########################################################

# As in your logistic chunk, analyze the first specified response.
response_col <- response_cols[[1]]

predictors <- predictor_cols_base[
  predictor_cols_base != response_col
]

# data_Biomarker was created before row_id was added.
# Therefore row_id is not included as a candidate biomarker.
biomarker_names <- names(data_Biomarker)

if (length(biomarker_names) == 0) {
  stop("No candidate biomarkers are available.")
}

if (
  !all(
    c(response_col, predictors, biomarker_names) %in% names(data)
  )
) {
  stop("Some response or predictor columns are missing from data.")
}

if (
  response_col %in% biomarker_names ||
  length(intersect(predictors, biomarker_names)) > 0
) {
  stop("Response, mandatory predictors and biomarkers must not overlap.")
}

if ("Biomarker" %in% c(response_col, predictors)) {
  stop(
    "'Biomarker' is reserved as the temporary biomarker column name."
  )
}


# Check numeric columns for non-finite values.
# Global scale() can produce NaN for constant nonzero columns.
analysis_columns <- unique(
  c(response_col, predictors, biomarker_names)
)

nonfinite_columns <- analysis_columns[
  vapply(
    data[, analysis_columns, drop = FALSE],

    function(x) {
      is.numeric(x) && any(!is.finite(x))
    },

    logical(1)
  )
]

if (length(nonfinite_columns) > 0) {

  stop(
    "Non-finite values found in: ",
    paste(nonfinite_columns, collapse = ", "),
    ". Check for constant columns that became NaN during scaling."
  )
}

if (
  !is.numeric(data[[response_col]]) ||
  length(unique(data[[response_col]])) < 3
) {
  stop("A numeric continuous response is required.")
}

if (
  !all(
    vapply(
      data[, biomarker_names, drop = FALSE],
      is.numeric,
      logical(1)
    )
  )
) {
  stop("All candidate biomarkers must be numeric.")
}


##########################################################
############ Generate fixed train/test splits ############
##########################################################

splits <- vector("list", n_seeds)

for (seed in seq_len(n_seeds)) {

  set.seed(seed)

  # rsample stratifies continuous outcomes using outcome bins.
  splits[[seed]] <- rsample::initial_split(
    data,
    prop = 0.70,
    strata = tidyselect::all_of(response_col)
  )
}


# Save the exact split objects for reuse in elastic net and refits.
# Do not regenerate splits in subsequent chunks.
saveRDS(
  splits,
  "Individually Selected Predictors/Shared_Train_Test_Splits.rds"
)


##########################################################
################ Begin repeated-split loop ###############
##########################################################

for (seed in seq_len(n_seeds)) {

  cat("\n=========================\n")
  cat("Seed:", seed, "\n")
  cat("=========================\n")

  split <- splits[[seed]]

  train_raw <- rsample::training(split)

  test_data <- rsample::testing(split)


  baseline_formula <- make_linear_formula(
    response = response_col,
    predictors = predictors
  )


  # Preserve your existing object names.
  # For continuous outcomes, no class balancing is performed.
  balanced_train_data <- train_raw

  balanced_weights <- rep(
    1,
    nrow(balanced_train_data)
  )


  ########################################################
  ############ Baseline multiple linear model ############
  ########################################################

  baseline_model_balanced <- lm(
    formula = baseline_formula,
    data = balanced_train_data,
    weights = balanced_weights,
    na.action = na.fail
  )


  if (
    baseline_model_balanced$rank <
      length(coef(baseline_model_balanced)) ||
    df.residual(baseline_model_balanced) <= 0
  ) {

    stop(
      "The baseline model is not estimable in seed ",
      seed,
      ". Check collinearity, categorical levels and sample size."
    )
  }


  baseline_predictions <- predict(
    baseline_model_balanced,
    newdata = test_data
  )


  baseline_metrics <- calculate_regression_metrics(
    actual = test_data[[response_col]],
    predicted = baseline_predictions
  )


  baseline_summary <- summary(
    baseline_model_balanced
  )


  baseline_test_shapiro <- calculate_shapiro(
    test_data[[response_col]] - baseline_predictions
  )


  ########################################################
  ############ Individual biomarker analyses #############
  ########################################################

  # Start at 1, so the first biomarker is not skipped.
  for (i in seq_along(biomarker_names)) {

    colName <- biomarker_names[i]

    tryCatch({

      predictor_cols <- c(
        predictors,
        "Biomarker"
      )

      formula <- make_linear_formula(
        response = response_col,
        predictors = predictor_cols
      )


      temp_train <- train_raw

      temp_test <- test_data


      # Pull values from data, whose rows correspond to row_id.
      biomarker_values <- data[[colName]]


      temp_train$Biomarker <- biomarker_values[
        match(
          temp_train$row_id,
          data$row_id
        )
      ]

      temp_test$Biomarker <- biomarker_values[
        match(
          temp_test$row_id,
          data$row_id
        )
      ]


      model_data <- balanced_train_data

      case_weights <- balanced_weights


      model_data$Biomarker <- biomarker_values[
        match(
          model_data$row_id,
          data$row_id
        )
      ]


      # A globally varying biomarker may be constant in a split.
      if (
        !is.finite(sd(model_data$Biomarker)) ||
        sd(model_data$Biomarker) == 0
      ) {
        stop("Biomarker has zero variance in this training split.")
      }


      lm_biomarker <- lm(
        formula = formula,
        data = model_data,
        weights = case_weights,
        na.action = na.fail
      )


      if (
        lm_biomarker$rank < length(coef(lm_biomarker)) ||
        df.residual(lm_biomarker) <= 0
      ) {
        stop(
          "Biomarker model is rank deficient or has no residual degrees of freedom."
        )
      }


      biomarker_predictions <- predict(
        lm_biomarker,
        newdata = temp_test
      )


      biomarker_metrics <- calculate_regression_metrics(
        actual = temp_test[[response_col]],
        predicted = biomarker_predictions
      )


      ####################################################
      ################ ANOVA comparison ##################
      ####################################################

      anova_result <- anova(
        baseline_model_balanced,
        lm_biomarker,
        test = "F"
      )

      anova_lm <- anova_result$`Pr(>F)`[2]

      anova_f <- anova_result$F[2]


      ####################################################
      ################ Coefficient inference #############
      ####################################################

      summary_model <- summary(lm_biomarker)

      coef_df <- as.data.frame(
        summary_model$coefficients
      )

      coef_df$Predictor <- rownames(coef_df)

      rownames(coef_df) <- NULL

      coef_df$Seed <- seed

      coef_df$Biomarker <- colName

      coef_df$Response <- response_col


      # Preserve your logistic code's within-model FDR family.
      # This includes all coefficient tests in the model.
      coef_df$FDR <- p.adjust(
        coef_df$`Pr(>|t|)`,
        method = "fdr"
      )


      estimate_biomarker <-
        summary_model$coefficients[
          "Biomarker",
          "Estimate"
        ]

      se_biomarker <-
        summary_model$coefficients[
          "Biomarker",
          "Std. Error"
        ]

      t_biomarker <-
        summary_model$coefficients[
          "Biomarker",
          "t value"
        ]

      p_value_biomarker <-
        summary_model$coefficients[
          "Biomarker",
          "Pr(>|t|)"
        ]


      fdr_values <- p.adjust(
        summary_model$coefficients[, "Pr(>|t|)"],
        method = "fdr"
      )

      fdr_biomarker <- fdr_values["Biomarker"]


      ####################################################
      ################ Store model results ###############
      ####################################################

      results_list[[length(results_list) + 1L]] <-
        data.frame(

          Seed = seed,

          Biomarker = colName,

          Response = response_col,

          Estimate = unname(estimate_biomarker),

          SE = unname(se_biomarker),

          t_statistic = unname(t_biomarker),

          Pr = unname(p_value_biomarker),

          FDR = unname(fdr_biomarker),


          # Independent test-set performance
          R2_baseline = baseline_metrics$R2,

          R2_biomarker = biomarker_metrics$R2,

          Delta_R2 =
            biomarker_metrics$R2 -
            baseline_metrics$R2,


          RMSE_baseline = baseline_metrics$RMSE,

          RMSE_biomarker = biomarker_metrics$RMSE,

          # Positive values indicate improved performance.
          Delta_RMSE =
            baseline_metrics$RMSE -
            biomarker_metrics$RMSE,


          MAE_baseline = baseline_metrics$MAE,

          MAE_biomarker = biomarker_metrics$MAE,

          Delta_MAE =
            baseline_metrics$MAE -
            biomarker_metrics$MAE,


          ANOVA_F = anova_f,

          ANOVA_p_value = anova_lm,


          # Training-model diagnostics
          Train_R2_baseline =
            baseline_summary$r.squared,

          Train_R2_biomarker =
            summary_model$r.squared,


          Train_Adjusted_R2_baseline =
            baseline_summary$adj.r.squared,

          Train_Adjusted_R2_biomarker =
            summary_model$adj.r.squared,


          Train_RMSE_baseline =
            sqrt(
              mean(
                residuals(baseline_model_balanced)^2
              )
            ),

          Train_RMSE_biomarker =
            sqrt(
              mean(
                residuals(lm_biomarker)^2
              )
            ),


          Train_AIC_baseline =
            AIC(baseline_model_balanced),

          Train_AIC_biomarker =
            AIC(lm_biomarker),


          Train_BIC_baseline =
            BIC(baseline_model_balanced),

          Train_BIC_biomarker =
            BIC(lm_biomarker),


          Train_Shapiro_baseline =
            calculate_shapiro(
              residuals(baseline_model_balanced)
            ),

          Train_Shapiro_biomarker =
            calculate_shapiro(
              residuals(lm_biomarker)
            ),


          Test_Shapiro_baseline =
            baseline_test_shapiro,

          Test_Shapiro_biomarker =
            calculate_shapiro(
              temp_test[[response_col]] -
                biomarker_predictions
            ),


          Significant =
            p_value_biomarker < individual_p_threshold,

          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )


      predictor_results[[length(predictor_results) + 1L]] <-
        coef_df


      # Store predictions instead of ROC curves.
      prediction_storage[[
        paste(
          seed,
          response_col,
          colName,
          sep = "_"
        )
      ]] <- list(

        observed = temp_test[[response_col]],

        baseline = as.numeric(baseline_predictions),

        predicted = as.numeric(biomarker_predictions),

        row_id = temp_test$row_id,

        r2 = biomarker_metrics$R2,

        rmse = biomarker_metrics$RMSE,

        seed = seed,

        biomarker = colName,

        response = response_col
      )

    }, error = function(e) {

      failed_models[[length(failed_models) + 1L]] <<-
        data.frame(
          Seed = seed,
          Response = response_col,
          Biomarker = colName,
          Reason = conditionMessage(e),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )

      message(
        "Skipped seed ",
        seed,
        ", biomarker ",
        colName,
        ": ",
        conditionMessage(e)
      )
    })
  }

} # ---------------- END OF 50-SEED LOOP ----------------


###############################
#### Combine all results ######
###############################

results <- bind_rows(results_list)

predictor_results <- bind_rows(predictor_results)

failed_models <- bind_rows(failed_models)


if (nrow(failed_models) > 0) {

  write_xlsx(
    failed_models,
    "Individually Selected Predictors/Failed_Models.xlsx"
  )
}


if (nrow(results) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No individual biomarker models were successfully fitted. ",
    "See Failed_Models.xlsx."
  )
}


# Additional FDR correction across the biomarker screen,
# separately within each response and seed.
#
# FDR retains the original within-model calculation.
# FDR_across_biomarkers is a separate screening correction.
results <- results %>%

  group_by(
    Response,
    Seed
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    FDR_across_biomarkers = p.adjust(
      Pr,
      method = "fdr",
      n = length(biomarker_names)
    ),

    FDR_Significant =
      FDR_across_biomarkers < predictor_p_threshold

  ) %>%

  ungroup()


###############################
#### Summary across seeds #####
###############################

summary_results <-

  results %>%

  group_by(
    Response,
    Biomarker
  ) %>%

  summarise(

    Successful_splits = n(),

    Valid_R2_splits = sum(
      is.finite(R2_biomarker)
    ),


    Mean_Estimate = safe_mean(Estimate),

    SD_Estimate = safe_sd(Estimate),

    Mean_SE = safe_mean(SE),

    Mean_t = safe_mean(t_statistic),


    Mean_Pr = safe_mean(Pr),

    Median_Pr = safe_median(Pr),


    Mean_FDR = safe_mean(FDR),

    Mean_FDR_across_biomarkers =
      safe_mean(FDR_across_biomarkers),


    Mean_R2_baseline = safe_mean(R2_baseline),

    Lower95_R2_baseline =
      safe_quantile(R2_baseline, 0.025),

    Upper95_R2_baseline =
      safe_quantile(R2_baseline, 0.975),


    Mean_R2_biomarker = safe_mean(R2_biomarker),

    Lower95_R2_biomarker =
      safe_quantile(R2_biomarker, 0.025),

    Upper95_R2_biomarker =
      safe_quantile(R2_biomarker, 0.975),


    Mean_Delta_R2 = safe_mean(Delta_R2),

    Lower95_Delta_R2 =
      safe_quantile(Delta_R2, 0.025),

    Upper95_Delta_R2 =
      safe_quantile(Delta_R2, 0.975),


    Mean_RMSE_baseline = safe_mean(RMSE_baseline),

    Lower95_RMSE_baseline =
      safe_quantile(RMSE_baseline, 0.025),

    Upper95_RMSE_baseline =
      safe_quantile(RMSE_baseline, 0.975),


    Mean_RMSE_biomarker = safe_mean(RMSE_biomarker),

    Lower95_RMSE_biomarker =
      safe_quantile(RMSE_biomarker, 0.025),

    Upper95_RMSE_biomarker =
      safe_quantile(RMSE_biomarker, 0.975),


    Mean_Delta_RMSE = safe_mean(Delta_RMSE),

    Lower95_Delta_RMSE =
      safe_quantile(Delta_RMSE, 0.025),

    Upper95_Delta_RMSE =
      safe_quantile(Delta_RMSE, 0.975),


    Mean_MAE_baseline = safe_mean(MAE_baseline),

    Mean_MAE_biomarker = safe_mean(MAE_biomarker),

    Mean_Delta_MAE = safe_mean(Delta_MAE),


    Median_ANOVA = safe_median(ANOVA_p_value),

    Mean_ANOVA_F = safe_mean(ANOVA_F),


    Mean_Train_R2_baseline =
      safe_mean(Train_R2_baseline),

    Mean_Train_R2_biomarker =
      safe_mean(Train_R2_biomarker),


    Mean_Train_Adjusted_R2_baseline =
      safe_mean(Train_Adjusted_R2_baseline),

    Mean_Train_Adjusted_R2_biomarker =
      safe_mean(Train_Adjusted_R2_biomarker),


    Mean_Train_RMSE_baseline =
      safe_mean(Train_RMSE_baseline),

    Mean_Train_RMSE_biomarker =
      safe_mean(Train_RMSE_biomarker),


    Mean_Train_AIC_baseline =
      safe_mean(Train_AIC_baseline),

    Mean_Train_AIC_biomarker =
      safe_mean(Train_AIC_biomarker),


    Mean_Train_BIC_baseline =
      safe_mean(Train_BIC_baseline),

    Mean_Train_BIC_biomarker =
      safe_mean(Train_BIC_biomarker),


    Median_Train_Shapiro_baseline =
      safe_median(Train_Shapiro_baseline),

    Median_Train_Shapiro_biomarker =
      safe_median(Train_Shapiro_biomarker),


    Median_Test_Shapiro_baseline =
      safe_median(Test_Shapiro_baseline),

    Median_Test_Shapiro_biomarker =
      safe_median(Test_Shapiro_biomarker),


    Significant_frequency =
      sum(Significant, na.rm = TRUE),

    # Denominator remains all requested splits.
    Significant_percent =
      round(
        100 * sum(Significant, na.rm = TRUE) / n_seeds,
        1
      ),


    FDR_Significant_frequency =
      sum(FDR_Significant, na.rm = TRUE),

    FDR_Significant_percent =
      round(
        100 * sum(FDR_Significant, na.rm = TRUE) / n_seeds,
        1
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


###############################
##### Predictor summary #######
###############################

predictor_summary <-

  predictor_results %>%

  group_by(
    Response,
    Biomarker,
    Predictor
  ) %>%

  summarise(

    Successful_splits = n(),


    Mean_Estimate =
      safe_mean(Estimate),

    SD_Estimate =
      safe_sd(Estimate),


    Lower95_Estimate =
      safe_quantile(Estimate, 0.025),

    Upper95_Estimate =
      safe_quantile(Estimate, 0.975),


    Mean_SE =
      safe_mean(`Std. Error`),

    Mean_t =
      safe_mean(`t value`),


    Mean_Pr =
      safe_mean(`Pr(>|t|)`),

    Median_Pr =
      safe_median(`Pr(>|t|)`),


    Mean_FDR =
      safe_mean(FDR),


    Significant_frequency =
      sum(
        `Pr(>|t|)` < predictor_p_threshold,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    Significant_percent =
      round(
        100 *
          sum(
            `Pr(>|t|)` < predictor_p_threshold,
            na.rm = TRUE
          ) / n_seeds,
        1
      ),


    FDR_Significant_frequency =
      sum(
        FDR < predictor_p_threshold,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    FDR_Significant_percent =
      round(
        100 *
          sum(
            FDR < predictor_p_threshold,
            na.rm = TRUE
          ) / n_seeds,
        1
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    # Descriptive coefficient range across splits, not an OR.
    Estimate_display =
      sprintf(
        "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
        Mean_Estimate,
        Lower95_Estimate,
        Upper95_Estimate
      )

  )


###############################
##### Select Top 5 ############
###############################

# Preserve the original robustness rule:
# frequent nominal significance plus improved test performance.
#
# Delta_R2 replaces Delta_AUC.
# RMSE improvement is used as an additional ranking criterion.
robust_results <-

  summary_results %>%

  filter(
    Significant_frequency >= min_frequency,
    Mean_Delta_R2 > 0
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    desc(Significant_frequency),
    desc(Mean_Delta_R2),
    desc(Mean_Delta_RMSE),
    desc(Mean_R2_biomarker),
    Mean_Pr
  )


###############################
#### Display version ##########
###############################

robust_results_display <-

  robust_results %>%

  mutate(

    Mean_R2_baseline =
      sprintf(
        "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
        Mean_R2_baseline,
        Lower95_R2_baseline,
        Upper95_R2_baseline
      ),

    Mean_R2_biomarker =
      sprintf(
        "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
        Mean_R2_biomarker,
        Lower95_R2_biomarker,
        Upper95_R2_biomarker
      ),

    Mean_Delta_R2 =
      sprintf(
        "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
        Mean_Delta_R2,
        Lower95_Delta_R2,
        Upper95_Delta_R2
      ),


    Mean_RMSE_baseline =
      sprintf(
        "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
        Mean_RMSE_baseline,
        Lower95_RMSE_baseline,
        Upper95_RMSE_baseline
      ),

    Mean_RMSE_biomarker =
      sprintf(
        "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
        Mean_RMSE_biomarker,
        Lower95_RMSE_biomarker,
        Upper95_RMSE_biomarker
      ),

    Mean_Delta_RMSE =
      sprintf(
        "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
        Mean_Delta_RMSE,
        Lower95_Delta_RMSE,
        Upper95_Delta_RMSE
      )

  ) %>%

  select(
    Response,
    Biomarker,

    Successful_splits,

    Mean_Estimate,
    Mean_SE,
    Median_Pr,
    Mean_FDR,
    Mean_FDR_across_biomarkers,

    Mean_R2_baseline,
    Mean_R2_biomarker,
    Mean_Delta_R2,

    Mean_RMSE_baseline,
    Mean_RMSE_biomarker,
    Mean_Delta_RMSE,

    Mean_MAE_baseline,
    Mean_MAE_biomarker,

    Median_ANOVA,

    Significant_frequency,
    Significant_percent,

    FDR_Significant_frequency,
    FDR_Significant_percent
  )


top5 <-

  robust_results %>%

  slice_head(n = 5)


###############################
##### HTML table ##############
###############################

# Return the widget as a visible top-level expression so it
# renders in the knitted HTML document.
robust_widget <- datatable(
  robust_results_display,

  rownames = FALSE,

  caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
    style = paste(
      "caption-side: top;",
      "text-align: left;",
      "font-weight: bold;"
    ),

    paste0(
      "Average performance across ",
      n_seeds,
      " random stratified 70/30 train/test splits"
    )
  ),

  extensions = "Buttons",

  options = list(
    pageLength = 50,
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    dom = "Bfrtip",
    buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel"),
    order = list()
  )
)


numeric_display_columns <- names(
  robust_results_display
)[
  vapply(
    robust_results_display,
    is.numeric,
    logical(1)
  )
]


if (length(numeric_display_columns) > 0) {

  robust_widget <- formatRound(
    robust_widget,
    columns = numeric_display_columns,
    digits = 3
  )
}


htmltools::tagList(

  htmltools::tags$details(

    htmltools::tags$summary(
      style = "font-size:1.8em;",

      paste0(
        "Robust Biomarkers Across ",
        n_seeds,
        " Random Stratified 70/30 Splits"
      )
    ),

    htmltools::tags$br(),

    htmltools::tags$p(
      paste(
        "Parentheses show the 2.5th–97.5th percentiles",
        "across splits, not confidence intervals."
      )
    ),

    robust_widget
  )
)


###############################
##### Save Excel files ########
###############################

write_xlsx(
  results,
  "Individually Selected Predictors/Individual_Biomarkers_AllSeeds.xlsx"
)

write_xlsx(
  summary_results,
  "Individually Selected Predictors/Individual_Biomarkers_Summary.xlsx"
)

write_xlsx(
  robust_results_display,
  "Individually Selected Predictors/Robust_Biomarkers.xlsx"
)

write_xlsx(
  predictor_results,
  "Individually Selected Predictors/Predictor_Coefficients_AllSeeds.xlsx"
)

write_xlsx(
  predictor_summary,
  "Individually Selected Predictors/Predictor_Coefficients_Summary.xlsx"
)


# Preserve predictions for later plots and reproducibility.
saveRDS(
  prediction_storage,
  "Individually Selected Predictors/Individual_Biomarker_Predictions.rds"
)


###############################
##### Representative plots ####
###############################

cat(
  paste0(
    "<details><summary style='font-size:1.8em;'>",
    "Representative Observed versus Predicted Plots ",
    "(Top 5 Biomarkers)",
    "</summary><br>\n\n"
  )
)


if (nrow(top5) == 0) {

  cat(
    "No biomarkers met the specified robustness criteria.\n\n"
  )

} else {

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(top5))) {

    biomarker <- top5$Biomarker[i]

    target_r2 <- top5$Mean_R2_biomarker[i]


    tmp <-

      results %>%

      filter(
        Biomarker == biomarker,
        Response == top5$Response[i],
        is.finite(R2_biomarker)
      )


    if (nrow(tmp) == 0) {
      next
    }


    closest_seed <- tmp$Seed[
      which.min(
        abs(
          tmp$R2_biomarker - target_r2
        )
      )
    ]


    prediction_key <- paste(
      closest_seed,
      top5$Response[i],
      biomarker,
      sep = "_"
    )

    prediction_obj <- prediction_storage[[prediction_key]]


    plot_data <- data.frame(
      Observed = prediction_obj$observed,
      Predicted = prediction_obj$predicted
    )


    representative_plot <-

      ggplot(
        plot_data,
        aes(
          x = Observed,
          y = Predicted
        )
      ) +

      geom_point(
        alpha = 0.75,
        color = "#2166AC",
        size = 2
      ) +

      geom_abline(
        intercept = 0,
        slope = 1,
        linetype = "dashed",
        color = "#B2182B"
      ) +

      coord_equal() +

      theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

      labs(
        title = biomarker,

        subtitle = paste0(
          "Representative split: seed ",
          closest_seed,
          " | Test R² = ",
          sprintf("%.3f", prediction_obj$r2),
          " | Test RMSE = ",
          sprintf("%.3f", prediction_obj$rmse)
        ),

        x = "Observed outcome",

        y = "Predicted outcome",

        caption = paste(
          "Dashed line: perfect prediction.",
          "Representative split chosen for descriptive illustration only."
        )
      )


    print(representative_plot)
  }
}


cat("\n\n</details>\n")


###############################
##### Clean-up ################
###############################

# Keep data$row_id and splits unchanged.
# Elastic net and de-novo analyses must reuse these split objects.
#
# Keep results, summary_results, predictor_results,
# predictor_summary, robust_results and top5 for later chunks.

rm(results_list)
```

```{r results='asis'}



# Load necessary libraries for table display

# Escape variable names when inserting them into HTML
escape_html <- function(x) {
  as.character(

  )
}

for (response_var in unique(sorted_results$Response)) {

        " (",

        "/",

        " (",

        "–",
        round(response_results$Upper95_R2_baseline[i], 3),
        ")<br>",


        "<b>Mean biomarker-model test R²:</b> ",
        round(response_results$Mean_R2_biomarker[i], 3),
        " (empirical range: ",
        round(response_results$Lower95_R2_biomarker[i], 3),
        "–",
        round(response_results$Upper95_R2_biomarker[i], 3),
        ")<br>",


        "<b>Mean ΔR²:</b> ",
        round(response_results$Mean_Delta_R2[i], 3),
        " (empirical range: ",
        round(response_results$Lower95_Delta_R2[i], 3),
        "–",
        round(response_results$Upper95_Delta_R2[i], 3),
        ")<br><br>",


        "<b>Mean baseline test RMSE:</b> ",

        "<b>Mean biomarker-model test RMSE:</b> ",

        " (empirical range: ",

        ")<br><br>",

        round(response_results$Mean_MAE_baseline[i], 3),
        "<br>",


        "<b>Mean biomarker-model test MAE:</b> ",

        "<br>",

        ),
        "<br><br>",


        "<small>",
        "Empirical ranges show the 2.5th–97.5th percentiles ",
        "across splits; they are not confidence intervals. ",
        "Positive ΔR² and RMSE improvement indicate better ",
        "test prediction.",
        "</small><br><br>"

      )
    )


    ####################################################
    #### Save Excel ####################################
    ####################################################

    file_name <-
      paste0(
        "Models with Individually Selected Biomarkers/",

        gsub(
          "[^[:alnum:]_]",
          "_",
          model_name
        ),

        ".xlsx"
      )


    write_xlsx(
      predictors_df,
      path = file_name
    )


    cat(
      paste0(
        '<a href="',
        escape_html(file_name),
        '" download>',

        '</a><br><br>'
      )
    )


    ####################################################
    #### HTML table ####################################
    ####################################################

    kable(

      format = "html",

      caption = paste(

      align = "c",

    ) %>%

      kable_styling(
        bootstrap_options = c(
          "striped",
          "hover",
          "condensed",
          "responsive"
        ),

        full_width = FALSE,

        position = "center"
      ) %>%

      column_spec(
        1,
        bold = TRUE
      ) %>%

      row_spec(
        0,
        bold = TRUE,
        color = "white",
        background = "black"
      ) %>%

      print()


    cat(
      paste0(
        "<p><small>",
        "β ± SD summarizes coefficient estimates across splits. ",
        "Mean_SE is the average model-based standard error; ",
        "it differs from the across-split SD. ",
        "Mean_FDR and FDR_Significant_percent in this table use ",
        "the within-model correction retained from your logistic code. ",
        "Predictor significance percentages use a threshold of ",
        predictor_p_threshold,
        " and all ",
        n_seeds,
        " requested splits as the denominator.",
        "</small></p>"
      )
    )


    cat("</div></details><br>")
  }


  cat("</div></details><br>")
}



```


A categorical variable that for example contains values from 1 to 4 in the original dataset will only show levels 2 to 4 in the output of the model. This suggests that the reference level in the model is set to level 1, meaning the coefficients for levels 2 to 4 represent differences compared to level 1. When using a categorical variable in model regression, R automatically treats one of the levels as the reference category, comparing all other levels against it. This is standard practice for handling categorical predictors in regression models.

## Performing Elastic Net and obtaining the cross-validation plots


We also calculate here the performance of the model generated by machine learning, as well as the performance of the model using the same matrix ustilised for machine learning and the same machine learning algorithm. This will not result in any "chosen" variable since we are forcing the machine learning algorithm to use the predictors that we consider mandatory, but it will give us a performance of the "machine learning - baseline model" that we can compare with the performance of the models generated by machine learning when freely choosing biomarkers within our omic dataset. These will indicate how good the machine learning model predictions are, specially compared with a baseline model without biomarkers from our omics data.


Removed for loop over response_cols as they is only one which was used for the splitting of the data into training and test sets, which we used at the beginning of the code for both our individual marker selection loop and our elastic net marker selection loop!!! 


```{r results='asis'}




############################################################
################ Elastic Net initialization ################
############################################################

library(glmnet)
library(rsample)
library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr)
library(writexl)
library(broom)


############################################################
################ TODO User settings ########################
############################################################

response_cols <- colnames(data)[columns_response]

# Preserve the original chunk's first-response behavior.
response_col <- response_cols[[1]]

exclude_columns <- c(response_cols, "row_id")

# Requested grid: 11 alpha values x 2 fold settings.
alpha_values <- seq(0.05, 1, 0.05)

nfolds_values <- c(5,10,20)

# Mandatory-only Ridge baseline uses 10-fold CV.
baseline_nfolds <- 10L

# Reuse n_seeds and splits from the individual-biomarker chunk.
# Do not regenerate the train/test splits here.
if (
  !exists("splits") ||
  !exists("n_seeds") ||
  length(splits) != n_seeds
) {
  stop("Run the individual-biomarker chunk to create the shared splits first.")
}


############# TODO #####################


if (n_seeds != 50) {
  stop("The requested workflow requires 50 shared splits.")
}

required_helpers <- c(
  "make_linear_formula",
  "calculate_regression_metrics",
  "calculate_shapiro",
  "safe_mean",
  "safe_median",
  "safe_sd",
  "safe_quantile"
)

missing_helpers <- required_helpers[
  !vapply(
    required_helpers,
    exists,
    logical(1),
    mode = "function"
  )
]

if (length(missing_helpers) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Run the preceding individual-biomarker chunk first. Missing helpers: ",
    paste(missing_helpers, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

main_predictors <- setdiff(
  colnames(data)[columns_predictors],
  exclude_columns
)

biomarker_names <- setdiff(
  names(data_Biomarker),
  exclude_columns
)

if (length(intersect(main_predictors, biomarker_names)) > 0) {
  stop("Mandatory predictors and candidate biomarkers overlap.")
}

if (!length(main_predictors) || !length(biomarker_names)) {
  stop("Both mandatory predictors and candidate biomarkers are required.")
}


############################################################
################ Preserve previous results #################
############################################################

# This chunk reuses results and summary_results, as your
# logistic code did. Preserve the individual-biomarker tables.
individual_results <- results

individual_summary_results <- summary_results


############################################################
################ Storage ###################################
############################################################

results_list <- list()

coef_list <- list()

selected_variables_list <- list()

biomarker_selection_list <- list()

elastic_prediction_storage <- list()

warnings <- character()

failure_list <- list()

design_mapping_list <- list()

baseline_results_list <- list()

baseline_coef_list <- list()


############################################################
############ Store cv.glmnet objects ########################
############################################################

cv_models <- list()

baseline_cv_models <- list()

# Same fold IDs are reused across alpha values within a split.
cv_fold_storage <- list()


############################################################
############### De novo refitting storage ##################
############################################################

refit_results_list <- list()

refit_coef_list <- list()

refit_prediction_storage <- list()

refit_baseline_coef_list <- list()


############################################################
################ Helper functions ##########################
############################################################

# Create balanced-size CV folds spread across the
# continuous-outcome distribution.
make_regression_folds <- function(y, k, seed_value) {

  if (length(y) < 3 * k) {
    stop(
      "At least ",
      3 * k,
      " training observations are required for ",
      k,
      "-fold CV with at least three observations per fold."
    )
  }

  set.seed(seed_value)

  ordered_rows <- order(y, runif(length(y)))

  blocks <- split(
    ordered_rows,
    ceiling(seq_along(ordered_rows) / k)
  )

  fold_id <- integer(length(y))

  for (block in blocks) {
    fold_id[block] <- sample.int(k, length(block))
  }

  fold_id
}


# Training diagnostics for ordinary linear models.
get_lm_diagnostics <- function(fit) {

  s <- summary(fit)

  c(
    R2 = s$r.squared,
    Adjusted_R2 = s$adj.r.squared,
    RMSE = sqrt(mean(residuals(fit)^2)),
    AIC = AIC(fit),
    BIC = BIC(fit),
    Shapiro = calculate_shapiro(residuals(fit))
  )
}


# Check that ordinary linear-model inference is identifiable.
check_lm_fit <- function(fit) {

  if (fit$rank < length(coef(fit))) {
    stop("OLS model is rank deficient: collinear or too many predictors.")
  }

  if (df.residual(fit) <= 0) {
    stop("OLS model has no residual degrees of freedom.")
  }

  invisible(fit)
}


############################################################
################ Warning handler ###########################
############################################################

warning_context <- "Initialization"

capture_warning <- function(w) {

  warnings <<- c(
    warnings,
    paste0(
      warning_context,
      ": ",
      conditionMessage(w)
    )
  )

  invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
}


############################################################
############## Start warning capture #######################
############################################################

withCallingHandlers({

  for (seed in seq_len(n_seeds)) {

    cat("\n=========================\n")
    cat("Seed:", seed, "\n")
    cat("=========================\n")

    warning_context <- paste("Seed", seed)


    ########################################################
    ########### Reuse predefined stratified split ###########
    ########################################################

    split <- splits[[seed]]

    train_raw <- rsample::training(split)

    test_data <- rsample::testing(split)


    ########################################################
    ########### Training data / equal weights ###############
    ########################################################

    # Continuous response: no class balancing.
    # Keep every training observation.
    train_data <- train_raw

    sample_weights <- rep(
      1,
      nrow(train_data)
    )

    y_train <- train_data[[response_col]]

    y_test <- test_data[[response_col]]

    if (
      any(!is.finite(y_train)) ||
      any(!is.finite(y_test)) ||
      sd(y_train) == 0
    ) {
      stop("Invalid or constant training outcome in seed ", seed)
    }


    ########################################################
    ########### Validate predictors ########################
    ########################################################

    all_input_columns <- unique(
      c(main_predictors, biomarker_names)
    )

    if (!all(all_input_columns %in% names(train_data))) {
      stop("Some predictors are absent from the saved splits.")
    }

    nonfinite_columns <- all_input_columns[
      vapply(
        train_data[, all_input_columns, drop = FALSE],

        function(x) {
          is.numeric(x) && any(!is.finite(x))
        },

        logical(1)
      )
    ]

    if (length(nonfinite_columns) > 0) {
      stop(
        "Non-finite training values in seed ",
        seed,
        ": ",
        paste(nonfinite_columns, collapse = ", "),
        ". Check constant columns that became NaN during scaling."
      )
    }

    if (
      !all(
        vapply(
          train_data[, biomarker_names, drop = FALSE],
          is.numeric,
          logical(1)
        )
      )
    ) {
      stop("Candidate biomarkers must be numeric.")
    }

    # Exclude biomarkers that cannot be estimated in this split.
    # This does not modify the saved train/test split objects.
    active_biomarkers <- biomarker_names[
      vapply(
        train_data[, biomarker_names, drop = FALSE],
        function(x) sd(x) > 0,
        logical(1)
      )
    ]

    if (!length(active_biomarkers)) {
      stop("No varying biomarkers in training seed ", seed)
    }

    for (variable in main_predictors) {

      if (length(unique(train_data[[variable]])) < 2) {
        stop(
          "Mandatory predictor is constant in training seed ",
          seed,
          ": ",
          variable
        )
      }

      if (is.factor(train_data[[variable]])) {

        if (any(table(train_data[[variable]]) == 0)) {
          stop(
            "A categorical level is absent from training seed ",
            seed,
            ": ",
            variable,
            ". Review rare categories before running."
          )
        }
      }
    }


    ########################################################
    ########### Design matrices #############################
    ########################################################

    # Explicitly include only mandatory predictors and biomarkers.
    # Outcomes and row_id cannot enter the predictor matrix.
    predictor_variables <- c(
      main_predictors,
      active_biomarkers
    )

    x_train <- train_data[
      ,
      predictor_variables,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    x_test <- test_data[
      ,
      predictor_variables,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    active_factors <- names(x_train)[
      vapply(x_train, is.factor, logical(1))
    ]

    current_contrasts <- NULL

    if (length(active_factors) > 0) {

      current_contrasts <- lapply(
        setNames(active_factors, active_factors),

        function(variable) {
          contrasts(
            x_train[[variable]],
            contrasts = TRUE
          )
        }
      )
    }

    # Include an intercept while constructing treatment contrasts,
    # then remove the intercept column because glmnet fits its own.
    train_design <- model.matrix(
      ~ .,
      data = x_train,
      contrasts.arg = current_contrasts
    )

    test_design <- model.matrix(
      ~ .,
      data = x_test,
      contrasts.arg = current_contrasts
    )

    design_assign <- attr(
      train_design,
      "assign"
    )[-1]

    x_train_matrix <- train_design[
      ,
      -1,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    if (anyDuplicated(colnames(x_train_matrix))) {
      stop("Duplicate design-matrix column names. Rename conflicting variables.")
    }

    if (
      !all(
        colnames(x_train_matrix) %in% colnames(test_design)
      )
    ) {
      stop("Training and test design matrices have incompatible columns.")
    }

    x_test_matrix <- test_design[
      ,
      colnames(x_train_matrix),
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    if (
      any(!is.finite(x_train_matrix)) ||
      any(!is.finite(x_test_matrix))
    ) {
      stop("Non-finite design-matrix values in seed ", seed)
    }

    predictor_names <- colnames(x_train_matrix)

    # With ~ . and no interactions, term assignments correspond
    # to the columns of x_train in their original order.
    design_source <- names(x_train)[design_assign]

    # Automatically identify mandatory columns, including dummies.
    columns_predictors_x <- which(
      design_source %in% main_predictors
    )

    if (length(columns_predictors_x) < 2) {
      stop("The glmnet Ridge baseline requires at least two design columns.")
    }

    design_mapping_list[[length(design_mapping_list) + 1L]] <-
      data.frame(
        Seed = seed,
        Response = response_col,
        Design_column = predictor_names,
        Original_variable = design_source,
        Mandatory = design_source %in% main_predictors,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )


    ########################################################
    ########### Define shared internal CV folds #############
    ########################################################

    fold_ids <- list()

    for (
      k in sort(
        unique(c(nfolds_values, baseline_nfolds))
      )
    ) {

      fold_ids[[as.character(k)]] <-
        make_regression_folds(
          y = y_train,
          k = k,
          seed_value = seed + 1000L * k
        )
    }

    cv_fold_storage[[
      paste(response_col, seed, sep = "_")
    ]] <- list(
      row_id = train_data$row_id,
      folds = fold_ids
    )


    ########################################################
    ################ Baseline Ridge model ##################
    ########################################################

    warning_context <- paste(
      "Seed",
      seed,
      "baseline Ridge"
    )

    baseline_matrix <- x_train_matrix[
      ,
      columns_predictors_x,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    baseline_test_matrix <- x_test_matrix[
      ,
      columns_predictors_x,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    baseline_cvfit <- cv.glmnet(
      x = baseline_matrix,
      y = y_train,

      family = "gaussian",

      alpha = 0,

      nfolds = baseline_nfolds,

      foldid = fold_ids[[
        as.character(baseline_nfolds)
      ]],

      type.measure = "mse",

      # Preserve your existing scaling convention.
      standardize = FALSE,

      weights = sample_weights
    )

    baseline_lambda <- baseline_cvfit$lambda.min

    baseline_cv_models[[
      paste(response_col, seed, sep = "_")
    ]] <- baseline_cvfit

    # Refit the lambda path to retain glmnet warm starts.
    # Prediction and coefficients are extracted at lambda.min.
    baseline_model <- glmnet(
      x = baseline_matrix,
      y = y_train,

      family = "gaussian",

      alpha = 0,

      lambda = baseline_cvfit$lambda,

      standardize = FALSE,

      weights = sample_weights
    )

    baseline_predictions <- as.numeric(
      predict(
        baseline_model,
        newx = baseline_test_matrix,
        s = baseline_lambda,
        type = "response"
      )
    )

    baseline_metrics <- calculate_regression_metrics(
      actual = y_test,
      predicted = baseline_predictions
    )

    baseline_test_shapiro <- calculate_shapiro(
      y_test - baseline_predictions
    )

    baseline_results_list[[length(baseline_results_list) + 1L]] <-
      data.frame(
        Seed = seed,
        Response = response_col,
        nfolds = baseline_nfolds,
        Lambda_min = baseline_lambda,
        Lambda_1se = baseline_cvfit$lambda.1se,
        CV_MSE = min(baseline_cvfit$cvm),
        Test_R2 = baseline_metrics$R2,
        Test_RMSE = baseline_metrics$RMSE,
        Test_MAE = baseline_metrics$MAE,
        Test_Shapiro = baseline_test_shapiro
      )

    baseline_coefficients <- as.matrix(
      coef(
        baseline_model,
        s = baseline_lambda
      )
    )

    baseline_coef_list[[length(baseline_coef_list) + 1L]] <-
      data.frame(
        Seed = seed,
        Response = response_col,
        Variable = rownames(baseline_coefficients),
        Coefficient = baseline_coefficients[, 1],
        row.names = NULL
      )


    ########################################################
    ########### Baseline OLS for de-novo comparisons #########
    ########################################################

    baseline_formula <- make_linear_formula(
      response = response_col,
      predictors = main_predictors
    )

    baseline_lm <- lm(
      formula = baseline_formula,
      data = train_data,
      weights = sample_weights,
      na.action = na.fail
    )

    check_lm_fit(baseline_lm)

    baseline_predictions_lm <- as.numeric(
      predict(
        baseline_lm,
        newdata = test_data
      )
    )

    baseline_metrics_lm <- calculate_regression_metrics(
      actual = y_test,
      predicted = baseline_predictions_lm
    )

    baseline_train_diagnostics <- get_lm_diagnostics(
      baseline_lm
    )

    baseline_test_shapiro_lm <- calculate_shapiro(
      y_test - baseline_predictions_lm
    )

    refit_baseline_coef_list[[
      length(refit_baseline_coef_list) + 1L
    ]] <-
      broom::tidy(baseline_lm) %>%
      mutate(
        FDR = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"),
        Seed = seed,
        Response = response_col
      )


    ########################################################
    ########## Loop over nfolds #############################
    ########################################################

    for (nfolds_val in nfolds_values) {


      ######################################################
      ########### Loop over alpha ##########################
      ######################################################

      for (alpha_val in alpha_values) {

        warning_context <- paste(
          "Seed", seed,
          "alpha", alpha_val,
          "folds", nfolds_val
        )

        tryCatch({

          penalty.factor <- rep(
            1,
            ncol(x_train_matrix)
          )

          penalty.factor[columns_predictors_x] <- 0


          ##################################################
          ################ Fit Elastic Net #################
          ##################################################

          cvfit <- cv.glmnet(
            x = x_train_matrix,
            y = y_train,

            family = "gaussian",

            alpha = alpha_val,

            nfolds = nfolds_val,

            foldid = fold_ids[[
              as.character(nfolds_val)
            ]],

            type.measure = "mse",

            penalty.factor = penalty.factor,

            standardize = FALSE,

            weights = sample_weights
          )

          lambda_min <- cvfit$lambda.min

          lambda_1se <- cvfit$lambda.1se

          cv_mse <- min(cvfit$cvm)

          if (!is.finite(cv_mse)) {
            stop("Cross-validation returned a non-finite MSE.")
          }


          ##################################################
          ############ Store CV model ######################
          ##################################################

          cv_key <- paste(
            response_col,
            alpha_val,
            nfolds_val,
            seed,
            sep = "_"
          )

          cv_models[[cv_key]] <- cvfit


          ##################################################
          ################ Final model #####################
          ##################################################

          model <- glmnet(
            x = x_train_matrix,
            y = y_train,

            family = "gaussian",

            alpha = alpha_val,

            lambda = cvfit$lambda,

            penalty.factor = penalty.factor,

            standardize = FALSE,

            weights = sample_weights
          )


          ##################################################
          ################ Test predictions ################
          ##################################################

          predictions <- as.numeric(
            predict(
              model,
              newx = x_test_matrix,
              s = lambda_min,
              type = "response"
            )
          )

          elastic_metrics <- calculate_regression_metrics(
            actual = y_test,
            predicted = predictions
          )


          ##################################################
          ######## Number of selected predictors ###########
          ##################################################

          coefficient_matrix <- as.matrix(
            coef(
              model,
              s = lambda_min
            )
          )

          coef_vector <- coefficient_matrix[, 1]

          coef_names <- rownames(coefficient_matrix)

          # Nonzero biomarker coefficients define the panel.
          # Mandatory predictors remain in the signature
          # even if an estimated coefficient equals zero.
          selected_biomarkers <- unique(
            design_source[
              coef_vector[-1] != 0 &
                !(design_source %in% main_predictors)
            ]
          )

          all_predictors <- unique(
            c(
              main_predictors,
              selected_biomarkers
            )
          )

          # Count design columns, including factor dummies.
          selected_predictors <- sum(
            (coef_vector[-1] != 0) |
              (design_source %in% main_predictors)
          )


          ##################################################
          ######## Store model performance #################
          ##################################################

          results_list[[length(results_list) + 1L]] <-
            data.frame(
              Seed = seed,
              Response = response_col,
              Alpha = alpha_val,
              nfolds = nfolds_val,

              Lambda_min = lambda_min,
              Lambda_1se = lambda_1se,
              CV_MSE = cv_mse,

              Baseline_R2 = baseline_metrics$R2,
              ElasticNet_R2 = elastic_metrics$R2,

              Delta_R2 =
                elastic_metrics$R2 -
                baseline_metrics$R2,

              Baseline_RMSE = baseline_metrics$RMSE,
              ElasticNet_RMSE = elastic_metrics$RMSE,

              # Positive means improved prediction.
              Delta_RMSE =
                baseline_metrics$RMSE -
                elastic_metrics$RMSE,

              Baseline_MAE = baseline_metrics$MAE,
              ElasticNet_MAE = elastic_metrics$MAE,

              Delta_MAE =
                baseline_metrics$MAE -
                elastic_metrics$MAE,

              Test_Shapiro_baseline =
                baseline_test_shapiro,

              Test_Shapiro_full =
                calculate_shapiro(y_test - predictions),

              Selected_predictors = selected_predictors,

              Selected_biomarkers =
                length(selected_biomarkers),

              Signature_predictors =
                length(all_predictors),

              Biomarker_panel = paste(
                selected_biomarkers,
                collapse = "; "
              ),

              Signature = paste(
                all_predictors,
                collapse = "; "
              ),

              stringsAsFactors = FALSE
            )


          ##################################################
          ######## Store coefficients ######################
          ##################################################

          mandatory_flags <- c(
            FALSE,
            design_source %in% main_predictors
          )

          coef_df <- data.frame(
            Seed = seed,
            Response = response_col,
            Alpha = alpha_val,
            nfolds = nfolds_val,

            Variable = coef_names,

            Original_variable = c(
              "(Intercept)",
              design_source
            ),

            Coefficient = as.numeric(coef_vector),

            Nonzero = coef_vector != 0,

            Mandatory = mandatory_flags,

            Selected =
              (coef_vector != 0) | mandatory_flags,

            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )

          coef_list[[length(coef_list) + 1L]] <- coef_df


          ##################################################
          ######## Store selected variables ################
          ##################################################

          selected_df <-
            coef_df %>%

            filter(
              Variable != "(Intercept)",
              Selected
            ) %>%

            transmute(
              Seed,
              Response,
              Alpha,
              nfolds,
              Variable,
              Original_variable,
              Mandatory
            )

          selected_variables_list[[
            length(selected_variables_list) + 1L
          ]] <- selected_df

          # Include unselected biomarkers too, so selection
          # frequencies can explicitly be zero.
          biomarker_selection_list[[
            length(biomarker_selection_list) + 1L
          ]] <-
            data.frame(
              Seed = seed,
              Response = response_col,
              Alpha = alpha_val,
              nfolds = nfolds_val,
              Biomarker = biomarker_names,

              Selected =
                biomarker_names %in% selected_biomarkers,

              Eligible =
                biomarker_names %in% active_biomarkers
            )


          ##################################################
          ######## Store Elastic Net predictions ###########
          ##################################################

          prediction_key <- paste(
            seed,
            response_col,
            alpha_val,
            nfolds_val,
            sep = "_"
          )

          elastic_prediction_storage[[prediction_key]] <-
            list(
              observed = y_test,
              predicted = predictions,
              baseline = baseline_predictions,
              row_id = test_data$row_id,
              r2 = elastic_metrics$R2,
              rmse = elastic_metrics$RMSE,
              seed = seed,
              response = response_col,
              alpha = alpha_val,
              nfolds = nfolds_val
            )


          ##################################################
          ############### De novo linear refit #############
          ##################################################

          # Mapping through model.matrix assignments replaces
          # prefix matching of factor dummy names.
          predictor_vars <- selected_biomarkers

          full_formula <- make_linear_formula(
            response = response_col,
            predictors = all_predictors
          )


          ##################################################
          ################ Fit full OLS model ##############
          ##################################################

          refit_attempt <- tryCatch({

            full_lm <- lm(
              formula = full_formula,
              data = train_data,
              weights = sample_weights,
              na.action = na.fail
            )

            check_lm_fit(full_lm)

            full_predictions <- as.numeric(
              predict(
                full_lm,
                newdata = test_data
              )
            )

            full_metrics <- calculate_regression_metrics(
              actual = y_test,
              predicted = full_predictions
            )

            full_train_diagnostics <- get_lm_diagnostics(
              full_lm
            )


            ################################################
            ################ ANOVA F test ##################
            ################################################

            if (length(selected_biomarkers) == 0) {

              # Baseline and full formulas are identical.
              anova_p <- NA_real_

              anova_f <- NA_real_

            } else {

              anova_result <- anova(
                baseline_lm,
                full_lm,
                test = "F"
              )

              anova_p <- anova_result$`Pr(>F)`[2]

              anova_f <- anova_result$F[2]
            }


            ################################################
            ############ Model coefficients ################
            ################################################

            tidy_model <-
              broom::tidy(full_lm) %>%

              mutate(
                # statistic is a t statistic for lm().
                FDR = p.adjust(
                  p.value,
                  method = "fdr"
                ),

                Seed = seed,
                Response = response_col,
                Alpha = alpha_val,
                nfolds = nfolds_val
              )

            list(
              ok = TRUE,
              reason = "",
              predictions = full_predictions,
              metrics = full_metrics,
              diagnostics = full_train_diagnostics,
              anova_p = anova_p,
              anova_f = anova_f,
              coefficients = tidy_model
            )

          }, error = function(e) {

            list(
              ok = FALSE,
              reason = conditionMessage(e)
            )
          })


          ##################################################
          ############ Record failed refits ################
          ##################################################

          if (!refit_attempt$ok) {

            failure_list[[length(failure_list) + 1L]] <-
              data.frame(
                Seed = seed,
                Response = response_col,
                Alpha = alpha_val,
                nfolds = nfolds_val,
                Stage = "De_novo_OLS",
                Reason = refit_attempt$reason
              )

            # Preserve the panel and failure in the results.
            # Do not invent OLS inference for a singular model.
            full_predictions <- rep(
              NA_real_,
              length(y_test)
            )

            full_metrics <- list(
              R2 = NA_real_,
              RMSE = NA_real_,
              MAE = NA_real_
            )

            full_train_diagnostics <- setNames(
              rep(
                NA_real_,
                length(baseline_train_diagnostics)
              ),
              names(baseline_train_diagnostics)
            )

            anova_p <- NA_real_

            anova_f <- NA_real_

          } else {

            full_predictions <- refit_attempt$predictions

            full_metrics <- refit_attempt$metrics

            full_train_diagnostics <-
              refit_attempt$diagnostics

            anova_p <- refit_attempt$anova_p

            anova_f <- refit_attempt$anova_f

            refit_coef_list[[
              length(refit_coef_list) + 1L
            ]] <- refit_attempt$coefficients
          }


          ##################################################
          ######## Store refitted predictions ##############
          ##################################################

          refit_prediction_storage[[prediction_key]] <-
            list(
              observed = y_test,
              predicted = full_predictions,
              baseline = baseline_predictions_lm,
              row_id = test_data$row_id,
              r2 = full_metrics$R2,
              rmse = full_metrics$RMSE,
              seed = seed,
              response = response_col,
              alpha = alpha_val,
              nfolds = nfolds_val,
              status = if (refit_attempt$ok) "ok" else "failed",
              panel = selected_biomarkers
            )


          ##################################################
          ######## Store refitted performance ##############
          ##################################################

          refit_results_list[[
            length(refit_results_list) + 1L
          ]] <-
            data.frame(
              Seed = seed,
              Response = response_col,
              Alpha = alpha_val,
              nfolds = nfolds_val,

              Status = if (refit_attempt$ok) {
                "ok"
              } else {
                "failed"
              },

              Failure_reason = refit_attempt$reason,

              Baseline_R2 = baseline_metrics_lm$R2,
              Refit_R2 = full_metrics$R2,

              Delta_R2 =
                full_metrics$R2 -
                baseline_metrics_lm$R2,

              Baseline_RMSE = baseline_metrics_lm$RMSE,
              Refit_RMSE = full_metrics$RMSE,

              Delta_RMSE =
                baseline_metrics_lm$RMSE -
                full_metrics$RMSE,

              Baseline_MAE = baseline_metrics_lm$MAE,
              Refit_MAE = full_metrics$MAE,

              Delta_MAE =
                baseline_metrics_lm$MAE -
                full_metrics$MAE,

              ANOVA_F = anova_f,
              ANOVA_p = anova_p,

              Test_Shapiro_baseline =
                baseline_test_shapiro_lm,

              Test_Shapiro_full =
                calculate_shapiro(
                  y_test - full_predictions
                ),

              Train_R2_baseline =
                unname(baseline_train_diagnostics["R2"]),

              Train_R2_full =
                unname(full_train_diagnostics["R2"]),

              Train_Adjusted_R2_baseline =
                unname(
                  baseline_train_diagnostics["Adjusted_R2"]
                ),

              Train_Adjusted_R2_full =
                unname(
                  full_train_diagnostics["Adjusted_R2"]
                ),

              Train_RMSE_baseline =
                unname(baseline_train_diagnostics["RMSE"]),

              Train_RMSE_full =
                unname(full_train_diagnostics["RMSE"]),

              Train_AIC_baseline =
                unname(baseline_train_diagnostics["AIC"]),

              Train_AIC_full =
                unname(full_train_diagnostics["AIC"]),

              Train_BIC_baseline =
                unname(baseline_train_diagnostics["BIC"]),

              Train_BIC_full =
                unname(full_train_diagnostics["BIC"]),

              Train_Shapiro_baseline =
                unname(baseline_train_diagnostics["Shapiro"]),

              Train_Shapiro_full =
                unname(full_train_diagnostics["Shapiro"]),

              # Preserve the original meaning:
              # number of added biomarkers, excluding mandatory terms.
              Number_predictors =
                length(selected_biomarkers),

              Signature_predictors =
                length(all_predictors),

              Selected_biomarkers = paste(
                selected_biomarkers,
                collapse = "; "
              ),

              Signature = paste(
                all_predictors,
                collapse = "; "
              ),

              stringsAsFactors = FALSE
            )

        }, error = function(e) {

          failure_list[[length(failure_list) + 1L]] <<-
            data.frame(
              Seed = seed,
              Response = response_col,
              Alpha = alpha_val,
              nfolds = nfolds_val,
              Stage = "Elastic_net",
              Reason = conditionMessage(e)
            )

          message(
            "Failed: seed ",
            seed,
            ", alpha ",
            alpha_val,
            ", folds ",
            nfolds_val,
            ": ",
            conditionMessage(e)
          )
        })

      } # End alpha loop

    } # End nfolds loop

  } # End seed loop

}, warning = capture_warning)


############################################################
################ Combine all results #######################
############################################################

results <- bind_rows(results_list)

coefficients_df <- bind_rows(coef_list)

selected_variables <- bind_rows(
  selected_variables_list
)

biomarker_selection <- bind_rows(
  biomarker_selection_list
)

baseline_results <- bind_rows(
  baseline_results_list
)

baseline_coefficients_df <- bind_rows(
  baseline_coef_list
)

design_mapping <- bind_rows(
  design_mapping_list
)

failed_models_elastic <- bind_rows(
  failure_list
)

if (nrow(results) == 0) {
  print(failed_models_elastic)
  stop("No elastic-net models were successfully fitted.")
}


############################################################
############### Variable selection frequency ###############
############################################################

# Design-column frequency, retaining the original structure.
selection_frequency <-
  selected_variables %>%

  group_by(
    Response,
    Alpha,
    nfolds,
    Variable,
    Original_variable,
    Mandatory
  ) %>%

  summarise(
    Selected_splits = n_distinct(Seed),

    Selection_frequency =
      100 * n_distinct(Seed) / n_seeds,

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Biomarker-only frequencies, including zero-selection markers.
biomarker_selection_frequency <-
  biomarker_selection %>%

  group_by(
    Response,
    Alpha,
    nfolds,
    Biomarker
  ) %>%

  summarise(
    Successful_EN_fits = n_distinct(Seed),

    Eligible_splits = sum(Eligible),

    Selected_splits = sum(Selected),

    Selection_frequency =
      100 * sum(Selected) / n_seeds,

    .groups = "drop"
  )


############################################################
############ Combine de novo refitting results #############
############################################################

refit_results <- bind_rows(
  refit_results_list
)

refit_coefficients <- bind_rows(
  refit_coef_list
)

refit_baseline_coefficients <- bind_rows(
  refit_baseline_coef_list
)


############################################################
############### De novo summary ############################
############################################################

# Count failures explicitly. Performance summaries below use
# successful refits, with matched baseline/full observations.
refit_counts <- refit_results %>%

  group_by(
    Response,
    Alpha,
    nfolds
  ) %>%

  summarise(
    Attempted_refits = n(),

    Successful_refits = sum(Status == "ok"),

    Failed_refits = sum(Status != "ok"),

    Successful_refit_percent =
      100 * sum(Status == "ok") / n_seeds,

    .groups = "drop"
  )


refit_performance_summary <-
  refit_results %>%

  filter(Status == "ok") %>%

  group_by(
    Response,
    Alpha,
    nfolds
  ) %>%

  summarise(
    Valid_R2_splits = sum(is.finite(Refit_R2)),

    Mean_Baseline_R2 = safe_mean(Baseline_R2),

    Lower95_Baseline =
      safe_quantile(Baseline_R2, 0.025),

    Upper95_Baseline =
      safe_quantile(Baseline_R2, 0.975),

    Mean_Refit_R2 = safe_mean(Refit_R2),

    Lower95_Refit =
      safe_quantile(Refit_R2, 0.025),

    Upper95_Refit =
      safe_quantile(Refit_R2, 0.975),

    Mean_Delta_R2 = safe_mean(Delta_R2),

    Lower95_Delta =
      safe_quantile(Delta_R2, 0.025),

    Upper95_Delta =
      safe_quantile(Delta_R2, 0.975),

    Mean_Baseline_RMSE = safe_mean(Baseline_RMSE),

    Mean_Refit_RMSE = safe_mean(Refit_RMSE),

    Lower95_Refit_RMSE =
      safe_quantile(Refit_RMSE, 0.025),

    Upper95_Refit_RMSE =
      safe_quantile(Refit_RMSE, 0.975),

    Mean_Delta_RMSE = safe_mean(Delta_RMSE),

    Lower95_Delta_RMSE =
      safe_quantile(Delta_RMSE, 0.025),

    Upper95_Delta_RMSE =
      safe_quantile(Delta_RMSE, 0.975),

    Mean_Baseline_MAE = safe_mean(Baseline_MAE),

    Mean_Refit_MAE = safe_mean(Refit_MAE),

    Mean_Delta_MAE = safe_mean(Delta_MAE),

    Median_ANOVA = safe_median(ANOVA_p),

    # Percentage of ALL requested splits.
    Significant_ANOVA =
      100 * sum(ANOVA_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) / n_seeds,

    Mean_Selected = safe_mean(Number_predictors),

    SD_Selected = safe_sd(Number_predictors),

    across(
      c(
        Train_R2_baseline,
        Train_R2_full,
        Train_Adjusted_R2_baseline,
        Train_Adjusted_R2_full,
        Train_RMSE_baseline,
        Train_RMSE_full,
        Train_AIC_baseline,
        Train_AIC_full,
        Train_BIC_baseline,
        Train_BIC_full
      ),
```
