```{r results='asis'}
      safe_mean,
      .names = "Mean_{.col}"
    ),

    across(
      c(
        Train_Shapiro_baseline,
        Train_Shapiro_full,
        Test_Shapiro_baseline,
        Test_Shapiro_full
      ),
      safe_median,
      .names = "Median_{.col}"
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


refit_summary <-
  refit_counts %>%

  left_join(
    refit_performance_summary,
    by = c("Response", "Alpha", "nfolds")
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    desc(Mean_Refit_R2),
    desc(Mean_Delta_R2)
  )


############################################################
############### Refit coefficient summary ##################
############################################################

if (nrow(refit_coefficients) > 0) {

  refit_coefficients_summary <-
    refit_coefficients %>%

    group_by(
      Response,
      Alpha,
      nfolds,
      term
    ) %>%

    summarise(
      Estimated_splits = n_distinct(Seed),

      Mean_Beta = safe_mean(estimate),

      SD_Beta = safe_sd(estimate),

      Lower95_Beta =
        safe_quantile(estimate, 0.025),

      Upper95_Beta =
        safe_quantile(estimate, 0.975),

      Mean_SE = safe_mean(std.error),

      Mean_t = safe_mean(statistic),

      Median_p = safe_median(p.value),

      Mean_FDR = safe_mean(FDR),

      Significant_frequency =
        sum(p.value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),

      Significant_percent =
        100 * sum(p.value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) / n_seeds,

      FDR_Significant_frequency =
        sum(FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),

      FDR_Significant_percent =
        100 * sum(FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) / n_seeds,

      .groups = "drop"
    )

} else {

  refit_coefficients_summary <- tibble()
}


############################################################
################ Performance summary #######################
############################################################

summary_results <-
  results %>%

  group_by(
    Response,
    Alpha,
    nfolds
  ) %>%

  summarise(
    Successful_splits = n_distinct(Seed),

    Valid_R2_splits =
      sum(is.finite(ElasticNet_R2)),

    Mean_R2 = safe_mean(ElasticNet_R2),

    Lower95_R2 =
      safe_quantile(ElasticNet_R2, 0.025),

    Upper95_R2 =
      safe_quantile(ElasticNet_R2, 0.975),

    Mean_Baseline_R2 = safe_mean(Baseline_R2),

    Lower95_Baseline =
      safe_quantile(Baseline_R2, 0.025),

    Upper95_Baseline =
      safe_quantile(Baseline_R2, 0.975),

    Mean_Delta_R2 = safe_mean(Delta_R2),

    Lower95_Delta =
      safe_quantile(Delta_R2, 0.025),

    Upper95_Delta =
      safe_quantile(Delta_R2, 0.975),

    Mean_RMSE = safe_mean(ElasticNet_RMSE),

    Lower95_RMSE =
      safe_quantile(ElasticNet_RMSE, 0.025),

    Upper95_RMSE =
      safe_quantile(ElasticNet_RMSE, 0.975),

    Mean_Baseline_RMSE = safe_mean(Baseline_RMSE),

    Mean_Delta_RMSE = safe_mean(Delta_RMSE),

    Lower95_Delta_RMSE =
      safe_quantile(Delta_RMSE, 0.025),

    Upper95_Delta_RMSE =
      safe_quantile(Delta_RMSE, 0.975),

    Mean_MAE = safe_mean(ElasticNet_MAE),

    Mean_Baseline_MAE = safe_mean(Baseline_MAE),

    Mean_Delta_MAE = safe_mean(Delta_MAE),

    Mean_CV_MSE = safe_mean(CV_MSE),

    Mean_Lambda_min = safe_mean(Lambda_min),

    SD_Lambda_min = safe_sd(Lambda_min),

    Mean_Lambda_1se = safe_mean(Lambda_1se),

    SD_Lambda_1se = safe_sd(Lambda_1se),

    # Biomarker count, excluding mandatory predictors.
    Mean_Selected = safe_mean(Selected_biomarkers),

    SD_Selected = safe_sd(Selected_biomarkers),

    # Signature size measured as design columns.
    Mean_Selected_predictors =
      safe_mean(Selected_predictors),

    Median_Test_Shapiro_baseline =
      safe_median(Test_Shapiro_baseline),

    Median_Test_Shapiro_full =
      safe_median(Test_Shapiro_full),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


############################################################
################ Sort models ###############################
############################################################

# Descriptive ordering only.
# Do not use held-out R² to select the tuned model.
summary_results <-
  summary_results %>%

  arrange(
    desc(Mean_R2),
    desc(Mean_Delta_R2),
    Mean_Selected
  )


############################################################
############ Select configurations by training CV ##########
############################################################

# Select alpha/fold setting independently within each split,
# using internal training CV MSE only.
best_models_cv <-
  results %>%

  group_by(
    Response,
    Seed
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    CV_MSE,
    Alpha,
    nfolds,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%

  slice_head(n = 1) %>%

  ungroup()


best_model_keys <-
  best_models_cv %>%

  select(
    Response,
    Seed,
    Alpha,
    nfolds
  )


best_models_refit <-
  refit_results %>%

  inner_join(
    best_model_keys,
    by = c("Response", "Seed", "Alpha", "nfolds")
  )


best_models_cv_summary <-
  best_models_cv %>%

  group_by(Response) %>%

  summarise(
    Successful_splits = n_distinct(Seed),

    Mean_R2 = safe_mean(ElasticNet_R2),

    Lower95_R2 =
      safe_quantile(ElasticNet_R2, 0.025),

    Upper95_R2 =
      safe_quantile(ElasticNet_R2, 0.975),

    Mean_Delta_R2 = safe_mean(Delta_R2),

    Mean_RMSE = safe_mean(ElasticNet_RMSE),

    Mean_Delta_RMSE = safe_mean(Delta_RMSE),

    Mean_MAE = safe_mean(ElasticNet_MAE),

    Mean_Selected = safe_mean(Selected_biomarkers),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


############################################################
################ Display warnings ##########################
############################################################

warnings <- unique(warnings)

if (length(warnings) > 0) {

  cat(
    '<details><summary style="font-size:1.2em;"><strong>',
    length(warnings),
    ' unique warning(s) encountered during the analysis',
    '</strong></summary>'
  )

  cat('<div style="margin-left:20px;margin-top:10px;">')

  for (warn in warnings) {

    cat(
      "<p>",
      as.character(htmltools::htmlEscape(warn)),
      "</p>"
    )
  }

  cat("</div></details><br>")

} else {

  cat(
    "No warnings were encountered during the analysis.<br>"
  )
}


############################################################
################ Display fitting failures ##################
############################################################

if (nrow(failed_models_elastic) > 0) {

  cat(
    '<details><summary style="font-size:1.2em;"><strong>',
    nrow(failed_models_elastic),
    ' model-fitting failure(s)',
    '</strong></summary>'
  )

  cat('<div style="margin-left:20px;margin-top:10px;">')

  print(
    kable(
      failed_models_elastic,
      format = "html",
      escape = TRUE,
      row.names = FALSE
    )
  )

  cat("</div></details><br>")
}


```



## Obtaining the optimal lambda and the R2 (performance) of each regression model under different alpha values in elastic net

Here is shown the previously described performance of the model generated by machine learning, as well as the performance of the "machine learning basemodel". 

```{r results='asis'}


############################################################
################ Elastic Net summary tables ################
############################################################

library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(writexl)
library(dplyr)

output_directory <-
  "Machine Learning Models comparison and summary"

dir.create(
  output_directory,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


############################################################
################ Display helpers ###########################
############################################################

escape_html <- function(x) {
  as.character(
    htmltools::htmlEscape(as.character(x))
  )
}


format_empirical_range <- function(mean_value, lower, upper) {

  ifelse(
    is.finite(mean_value) &
      is.finite(lower) &
      is.finite(upper),

    sprintf(
      "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
      mean_value,
      lower,
      upper
    ),

    "—"
  )
}


format_mean_sd <- function(mean_value, sd_value, digits = 3) {

  pattern <- paste0(
    "%.",
    digits,
    "f ± %.",
    digits,
    "f"
  )

  ifelse(
    is.finite(mean_value) & is.finite(sd_value),

    sprintf(
      pattern,
      mean_value,
      sd_value
    ),

    "—"
  )
}


print_summary_table <- function(table, caption) {

  kable(
    table,

    format = "html",

    digits = 3,

    caption = caption,

    align = "c",

    escape = TRUE
  ) %>%

    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c(
        "striped",
        "hover",
        "condensed",
        "responsive"
      ),

      full_width = FALSE,

      position = "center"
    ) %>%

    row_spec(
      0,
      bold = TRUE,
      color = "white",
      background = "black"
    ) %>%

    print()
}


############################################################
################ Loop over responses #######################
############################################################

response_names <- unique(summary_results$Response)

for (response_index in seq_along(response_names)) {

  response_col <- response_names[response_index]

  # Safe HTML IDs independent of response-variable names.
  response_id <- paste0(
    "linear_en_response_",
    response_index
  )

  # Prefix prevents collisions between sanitized response names.
  response_file_prefix <- paste0(
    "Response_",
    response_index,
    "_",
    gsub(
      "[^[:alnum:]_-]",
      "_",
      response_col
    )
  )


  ##########################################################
  ################ Response collapsible ####################
  ##########################################################

  cat(
    paste0(
      '<div class="panel panel-default">',
      '<div class="panel-heading">',
      '<h4 class="panel-title">',
      '<a data-toggle="collapse" href="#',
      response_id,
      '">',
      'Elastic Net Results for Response: ',
      escape_html(response_col),
      '</a>',
      '</h4>',
      '</div>',
      '<div id="',
      response_id,
      '" class="panel-collapse collapse">',
      '<div class="panel-body">'
    )
  )


  ##########################################################
  ################ Loop over nfolds ########################
  ##########################################################

  response_folds <-
    summary_results %>%
    filter(Response == response_col) %>%
    pull(nfolds) %>%
    unique() %>%
    sort()


  for (nfolds_val in response_folds) {

    fold_id <- paste0(
      response_id,
      "_folds_",
      nfolds_val
    )


    ########################################################
    ################ Inner collapsible #####################
    ########################################################

    cat(
      paste0(
        '<div class="panel panel-default">',
        '<div class="panel-heading">',
        '<h5 class="panel-title">',
        '<a data-toggle="collapse" href="#',
        fold_id,
        '">',
        'Results for nfolds = ',
        nfolds_val,
        '</a>',
        '</h5>',
        '</div>',
        '<div id="',
        fold_id,
        '" class="panel-collapse collapse">',
        '<div class="panel-body">'
      )
    )

    cat(
      paste0(
        "<p><small>",
        "Ranges in parentheses are the 2.5th–97.5th ",
        "percentiles across splits, not confidence intervals. ",
        "Positive ΔR² and RMSE improvement indicate better ",
        "test prediction. Values shown as ± are mean ± SD ",
        "across splits.",
        "</small></p>"
      )
    )


    ########################################################
    ################ Summary table #########################
    ########################################################

    response_summary <-
      summary_results %>%

      filter(
        Response == response_col,
        nfolds == nfolds_val
      )


    summary_file <- file.path(
      output_directory,

      paste0(
        response_file_prefix,
        "_nfolds_",
        nfolds_val,
        "_ElasticNet_summary.xlsx"
      )
    )


    # Export the complete numeric summary.
    write_xlsx(
      response_summary,
      summary_file
    )


    cat(
      paste0(
        '<a href="',
        escape_html(summary_file),
        '" download>',
        'Download Elastic Net summary as Excel',
        '</a><br><br>'
      )
    )


    ########################################################
    ########### HTML version of summary table ##############
    ########################################################

    response_summary_html <-
      response_summary %>%

      mutate(

        R2 = format_empirical_range(
          Mean_R2,
          Lower95_R2,
          Upper95_R2
        ),

        Baseline_R2 = format_empirical_range(
          Mean_Baseline_R2,
          Lower95_Baseline,
          Upper95_Baseline
        ),

        Delta_R2 = format_empirical_range(
          Mean_Delta_R2,
          Lower95_Delta,
          Upper95_Delta
        ),

        RMSE = format_empirical_range(
          Mean_RMSE,
          Lower95_RMSE,
          Upper95_RMSE
        ),

        Delta_RMSE = format_empirical_range(
          Mean_Delta_RMSE,
          Lower95_Delta_RMSE,
          Upper95_Delta_RMSE
        ),

        Lambda_min = format_mean_sd(
          Mean_Lambda_min,
          SD_Lambda_min
        ),

        Lambda_1se = format_mean_sd(
          Mean_Lambda_1se,
          SD_Lambda_1se
        ),

        Selected_biomarkers = format_mean_sd(
          Mean_Selected,
          SD_Selected,
          digits = 2
        )

      ) %>%

      select(
        Response,
        Alpha,
        nfolds,

        Successful_splits,
        Valid_R2_splits,

        Baseline_R2,
        R2,
        Delta_R2,

        Mean_Baseline_RMSE,
        RMSE,
        Delta_RMSE,

        Mean_MAE,

        Mean_CV_MSE,

        Lambda_min,
        Lambda_1se,

        Selected_biomarkers
      ) %>%

      rename(
        `Successful splits` = Successful_splits,
        `Valid R² splits` = Valid_R2_splits,

        `Baseline test R²` = Baseline_R2,
        `Elastic Net test R²` = R2,
        `ΔR²` = Delta_R2,

        `Mean baseline RMSE` = Mean_Baseline_RMSE,
        `Elastic Net RMSE` = RMSE,
        `RMSE improvement` = Delta_RMSE,

        `Mean MAE` = Mean_MAE,

        `Mean CV MSE` = Mean_CV_MSE,

        `λmin ± SD` = Lambda_min,
        `λ1se ± SD` = Lambda_1se,

        `Selected biomarkers ± SD` = Selected_biomarkers
      )


    print_summary_table(
      response_summary_html,

      caption = paste(
        "Elastic Net performance summary for",
        response_col,
        "(nfolds =",
        nfolds_val,
        ")"
      )
    )


    cat(
      paste0(
        "<p><small>",
        "The comparator is the mandatory-only Ridge model. ",
        "Selected biomarker counts exclude mandatory predictors. ",
        "All models use λmin; λ1se is reported for reference. ",
        "Test-performance ordering is descriptive; ",
        "configuration selection uses training CV MSE.",
        "</small></p>"
      )
    )


    ########################################################
    ################ De novo summary #######################
    ########################################################

    refit_table <-
      refit_summary %>%

      filter(
        Response == response_col,
        nfolds == nfolds_val
      )


    if (nrow(refit_table) == 0) {

      cat(
        "<p>No de-novo refit results are available for this setting.</p>"
      )

    } else {

      refit_file <- file.path(
        output_directory,

        paste0(
          response_file_prefix,
          "_nfolds_",
          nfolds_val,
          "_Refitted_model_summary.xlsx"
        )
      )


      write_xlsx(
        refit_table,
        refit_file
      )


      cat(
        paste0(
          '<br><a href="',
          escape_html(refit_file),
          '" download>',
          'Download Refitted Model Summary as Excel',
          '</a><br><br>'
        )
      )


      refit_table_html <-
        refit_table %>%

        mutate(

          Baseline_R2 = format_empirical_range(
            Mean_Baseline_R2,
            Lower95_Baseline,
            Upper95_Baseline
          ),

          Refit_R2 = format_empirical_range(
            Mean_Refit_R2,
            Lower95_Refit,
            Upper95_Refit
          ),

          Delta_R2 = format_empirical_range(
            Mean_Delta_R2,
            Lower95_Delta,
            Upper95_Delta
          ),

          Refit_RMSE = format_empirical_range(
            Mean_Refit_RMSE,
            Lower95_Refit_RMSE,
            Upper95_Refit_RMSE
          ),

          Delta_RMSE = format_empirical_range(
            Mean_Delta_RMSE,
            Lower95_Delta_RMSE,
            Upper95_Delta_RMSE
          ),

          Significant_ANOVA = ifelse(
            is.finite(Significant_ANOVA),

            sprintf(
              "%.1f%%",
              Significant_ANOVA
            ),

            "—"
          ),

          Selected_biomarkers = format_mean_sd(
            Mean_Selected,
            SD_Selected,
            digits = 2
          )

        ) %>%

        select(
          Response,
          Alpha,
          nfolds,

          Attempted_refits,
          Successful_refits,
          Failed_refits,

          Baseline_R2,
          Refit_R2,
          Delta_R2,

          Mean_Baseline_RMSE,
          Refit_RMSE,
          Delta_RMSE,

          Mean_Refit_MAE,

          Median_ANOVA,
          Significant_ANOVA,

          Selected_biomarkers
        ) %>%

        rename(
          `Attempted refits` = Attempted_refits,
          `Successful refits` = Successful_refits,
          `Failed refits` = Failed_refits,

          `Baseline test R²` = Baseline_R2,
          `Refit test R²` = Refit_R2,
          `ΔR²` = Delta_R2,

          `Mean baseline RMSE` = Mean_Baseline_RMSE,
          `Refit RMSE` = Refit_RMSE,
          `RMSE improvement` = Delta_RMSE,

          `Mean refit MAE` = Mean_Refit_MAE,

          `Median ANOVA p` = Median_ANOVA,
          `Significant ANOVA (%)` = Significant_ANOVA,

          `Selected biomarkers ± SD` = Selected_biomarkers
        )


      print_summary_table(
        refit_table_html,

        caption = paste(
          "Refitted linear model performance summary for",
          response_col,
          "(nfolds =",
          nfolds_val,
          ")"
        )
      )


      cat(
        paste0(
          "<p><small>",
          "The comparator is the mandatory-only ordinary linear model. ",
          "Performance summaries include successful refits only, ",
          "using matched baseline/full-model comparisons. ",
          "Significant ANOVA is the percentage of all ",
          n_seeds,
          " requested splits with ANOVA p &lt; 0.05. ",
          "Training adjusted R², AIC and BIC are included ",
          "in the full Excel export.",
          "</small></p>"
        )
      )
    }


    ########################################################
    ############ Refitted coefficient summary ##############
    ########################################################

    # A completely empty coefficient table is possible if
    # every OLS refit failed.
    if (nrow(refit_coefficients_summary) == 0) {

      cat(
        "<p>No estimable de-novo coefficient summaries are available.</p>"
      )

    } else {

      coef_summary_raw <-
        refit_coefficients_summary %>%

        filter(
          Response == response_col,
          nfolds == nfolds_val
        )


      if (nrow(coef_summary_raw) == 0) {

        cat(
          "<p>No estimable de-novo coefficients are available for this setting.</p>"
        )

      } else {

        ####################################################
        ######## Prepare coefficient selection lookup #####
        ####################################################

        # model.matrix() and lm() may differ in backtick
        # presentation for nonstandard variable names.
        # Normalize only for joining; preserve displayed names.
        selection_lookup <-
          selection_frequency %>%

          mutate(
            term_key = gsub(
              "`",
              "",
              Variable,
              fixed = TRUE
            )
          ) %>%

          group_by(
            Response,
            Alpha,
            nfolds,
            term_key
          ) %>%

          summarise(
            Selection_frequency =
              max(Selection_frequency),

            .groups = "drop"
          )


        coef_summary_numeric <-
          coef_summary_raw %>%

          mutate(
            term_key = gsub(
              "`",
              "",
              term,
              fixed = TRUE
            )
          ) %>%

          left_join(
            selection_lookup,

            by = c(
              "Response",
              "Alpha",
              "nfolds",
              "term_key"
            )
          ) %>%

          mutate(
            Selection_frequency = ifelse(
              term == "(Intercept)",
              NA_real_,
              Selection_frequency
            )
          ) %>%

          select(-term_key) %>%

          relocate(
            Selection_frequency,
            .after = term
          )


        coef_summary <-
          coef_summary_numeric %>%

          mutate(

            Beta = format_mean_sd(
              Mean_Beta,
              SD_Beta
            ),

            Beta_range = ifelse(
              is.finite(Lower95_Beta) &
                is.finite(Upper95_Beta),

              sprintf(
                "%.3f–%.3f",
                Lower95_Beta,
                Upper95_Beta
              ),

              "—"
            )

          ) %>%

          rename(
            Predictor = term,

            `Selection (%)` = Selection_frequency,

            `Estimated splits` = Estimated_splits,

            `β ± SD` = Beta,

            `β empirical range` = Beta_range,

            `Mean SE` = Mean_SE,

            `Mean t` = Mean_t,

            `Median p` = Median_p,

            `Mean FDR` = Mean_FDR,

            `Significant (%)` = Significant_percent,

            `FDR-significant (%)` = FDR_Significant_percent
          ) %>%

          select(
            Response,
            Alpha,
            nfolds,
            Predictor,

            `Selection (%)`,
            `Estimated splits`,

            `β ± SD`,
            `β empirical range`,

            `Mean SE`,
            `Mean t`,

            `Median p`,
            `Mean FDR`,

            `Significant (%)`,
            `FDR-significant (%)`
          ) %>%

          arrange(
            Alpha,
            desc(`Selection (%)`),
            Predictor
          )


        ####################################################
        ######## Save refitted coefficient summary ########
        ####################################################

        coef_file <- file.path(
          output_directory,

          paste0(
            response_file_prefix,
            "_nfolds_",
            nfolds_val,
            "_Refitted_coefficients_summary.xlsx"
          )
        )


        # Preserve numeric values alongside the display table.
        write_xlsx(
          list(
            Numeric_summary = coef_summary_numeric,
            Display_summary = coef_summary
          ),

          path = coef_file
        )


        cat(
          paste0(
            '<br><a href="',
            escape_html(coef_file),
            '" download>',
            'Download Refitted Coefficient Summary as Excel',
            '</a><br><br>'
          )
        )


        ####################################################
        ######## Display coefficient summary ###############
        ####################################################

        # Format p-values only for HTML, preserving numeric
        # values in Excel and avoiding displays such as 0.000.
        coef_summary_html <-
          coef_summary %>%

          mutate(

            `Median p` = ifelse(
              is.finite(`Median p`),

              format.pval(
                `Median p`,
                digits = 3,
                eps = 0.001
              ),

              "—"
            ),

            `Mean FDR` = ifelse(
              is.finite(`Mean FDR`),

              format.pval(
                `Mean FDR`,
                digits = 3,
                eps = 0.001
              ),

              "—"
            )
          )


        print_summary_table(
          coef_summary_html,

          caption = paste(
            "Refitted linear model coefficient summary for",
            response_col,
            "(nfolds =",
            nfolds_val,
            ")"
          )
        )


        cat(
          paste0(
            "<p><small>",
            "Selection (%) reflects elastic-net inclusion across all ",
            n_seeds,
            " requested splits. Mandatory predictors are retained ",
            "in every successful elastic-net fit. ",
            "Estimated splits counts successful OLS refits ",
            "in which the coefficient was estimated. ",
            "Coefficient means and empirical ranges are conditional ",
            "on those estimable refits. ",
            "Mean SE is the average model-based standard error; ",
            "SD describes coefficient variation across splits. ",
            "Refitted p-values and FDR are exploratory after selection; ",
            "averaged FDR values and median p-values are descriptive ",
            "and are not pooled significance tests.",
            "</small></p>"
          )
        )
      }
    }


    ########################################################
    ################ Close nfolds panel ####################
    ########################################################

    cat("</div></div></div><br>")
  }


  ##########################################################
  ################ Close response panel ####################
  ##########################################################

  cat("</div></div></div><br>")
}






```






## Obtaining all the non-zero coefficients of the predictors chosen by elastic net for each alpha value and refitting the regression model de-novo using those predictors. 

A regression model will be generated de-novo with the standard regression, using the predictors with non-zero coefficients, in a process called refitting of the model. That de-novo model or refitted model will be compared by ANOVA with the baseline model generated with the standard regression. These models are different from the previous ones as they are generated with the typical regression instead of with elastic net ML, and now the machine learning algorithm is not used to perform predictions to obtain the performance of the models. If elastic net did not select any candidate biomarkeer, the de-novo (refitted) regression model = baseline model, so ANOVA p-value = NA and performance (R2 for linear regression) of baseline model and de-novo generated (refitted) model will be the same.

The first table will show the coefficients of the candidate biomarkers chosen within our omics data by elastic net as a suitable predictor of the response variables. The coefficients of predictors selected with the penalty.factor will always appear, and correspond to the predictors of the baseline model. Only when elastic net selects candidate biomarkers from our omics data, their coefficients will be also shown. 

The second table will show the estimates of those predictors after being used in a refitted model using the standard regression algorithm, not the machine learning one, and that is why significance of those predictors (p-values) can also be shown.

```{r results='asis'}



############################################################
############ Representative Elastic Net models #############
############################################################

library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(writexl)
library(ggplot2)

representative_directory <- "Representative Elastic Net Models"

dir.create(
  representative_directory,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


############################################################
################ Display helpers ###########################
############################################################

escape_html <- function(x) {
  as.character(
    htmltools::htmlEscape(as.character(x))
  )
}


print_representative_table <- function(table, caption) {

  kable(
    table,

    format = "html",

    digits = 3,

    caption = caption,

    align = "c",

    escape = TRUE
  ) %>%

    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c(
        "striped",
        "hover",
        "condensed",
        "responsive"
      ),

      full_width = FALSE,

      position = "center"
    ) %>%

    row_spec(
      0,
      bold = TRUE,
      color = "white",
      background = "black"
    ) %>%

    print()
}


# Restore graphics settings after drawing each CV plot.
plot_representative_cv <- function(cvfit) {

  old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)

  on.exit(
    par(old_par),
    add = TRUE
  )

  par(
    mar = c(5, 5, 5.5, 2),
    oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

  plot(cvfit)

  title(
    main = "Gaussian Elastic Net Cross-validation",
    cex.main = 1.0
  )
}


############################################################
############ Identify representative models ################
############################################################

representative_models <-

  refit_results %>%

  # Exclude failed refits and undefined test R².
  filter(
    Status == "ok",
    is.finite(Refit_R2)
  ) %>%

  group_by(
    Response,
    Alpha,
    nfolds
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    Mean_Refit_R2 = mean(
      Refit_R2
    ),

    Distance = abs(
      Refit_R2 - Mean_Refit_R2
    )

  ) %>%

  arrange(
    Distance,
    Seed,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%

  # Preserve your original choice of two representatives.
  slice_head(n = 2) %>%

  ungroup()


if (nrow(representative_models) == 0) {

  cat(
    paste0(
      "<p>No successful de-novo models with finite test R² ",
      "are available for representative plots.</p>"
    )
  )
}


############################################################
################ Loop over responses #######################
############################################################

representative_responses <- unique(
  representative_models$Response
)


for (response_index in seq_along(representative_responses)) {

  response_col <- representative_responses[response_index]

  response_id <- paste0(
    "representative_linear_response_",
    response_index
  )

  response_file_prefix <- paste0(
    "Response_",
    response_index,
    "_",
    gsub(
      "[^[:alnum:]_-]",
      "_",
      response_col
    )
  )


  cat(
    paste0(
      '<div class="panel panel-default">',
      '<div class="panel-heading">',
      '<h4 class="panel-title">',
      '<a data-toggle="collapse" href="#',
      response_id,
      '">',
      'Representative models for Response: ',
      escape_html(response_col),
      '</a>',
      '</h4>',
      '</div>',
      '<div id="',
      response_id,
      '" class="panel-collapse collapse">',
      '<div class="panel-body">'
    )
  )


  cat(
    paste0(
      "<p><small>",
      "These splits were selected for descriptive illustration ",
      "because their refit test R² is closest to the mean ",
      "within each alpha/fold configuration. ",
      "This is not independent selection or validation of ",
      "a final deployment model.",
      "</small></p>"
    )
  )


  ##########################################################
  ################ Loop over nfolds ########################
  ##########################################################

  response_folds <-
    representative_models %>%

    filter(
      Response == response_col
    ) %>%

    pull(nfolds) %>%

    unique() %>%

    sort()


  for (nfolds_val in response_folds) {

    fold_id <- paste0(
      response_id,
      "_folds_",
      nfolds_val
    )


    cat(
      paste0(
        '<div class="panel panel-default">',
        '<div class="panel-heading">',
        '<h5 class="panel-title">',
        '<a data-toggle="collapse" href="#',
        fold_id,
        '">',
        'nfolds = ',
        nfolds_val,
        '</a>',
        '</h5>',
        '</div>',
        '<div id="',
        fold_id,
        '" class="panel-collapse collapse">',
        '<div class="panel-body">'
      )
    )


    ########################################################
    ################ Loop over alpha #######################
    ########################################################

    response_alphas <-
      representative_models %>%

      filter(
        Response == response_col,
        nfolds == nfolds_val
      ) %>%

      pull(Alpha) %>%

      unique() %>%

      sort()


    for (alpha_val in response_alphas) {

      cat(
        paste0(
          '<details><summary><strong>Alpha = ',
          alpha_val,
          '</strong></summary><br>'
        )
      )


      rep_models <-
        representative_models %>%

        filter(
          Response == response_col,
          nfolds == nfolds_val,
          Alpha == alpha_val
        )


      if (nrow(rep_models) == 0) {

        cat(
          "No representative models found.<br><br>"
        )

      } else {


        ####################################################
        ######## Loop over representative seeds ############
        ####################################################

        for (i in seq_len(nrow(rep_models))) {

          this_seed <- rep_models$Seed[i]


          cat(
            paste0(
              "<h4>Representative model ",
              i,
              " (Seed ",
              this_seed,
              ")</h4>"
            )
          )


          cat(
            paste0(

              "<b>Baseline OLS test R²:</b> ",
              round(
                rep_models$Baseline_R2[i],
                3
              ),
              "<br>",


              "<b>Refitted test R²:</b> ",
              round(
                rep_models$Refit_R2[i],
                3
              ),
              "<br>",


              "<b>Mean refitted test R²:</b> ",
              round(
                rep_models$Mean_Refit_R2[i],
                3
              ),
              "<br>",


              "<b>Distance from mean R²:</b> ",
              round(
                rep_models$Distance[i],
                5
              ),
              "<br>",


              "<b>ΔR²:</b> ",
              round(
                rep_models$Delta_R2[i],
                3
              ),
              "<br><br>",


              "<b>Baseline OLS test RMSE:</b> ",
              round(
                rep_models$Baseline_RMSE[i],
                3
              ),
              "<br>",


              "<b>Refitted test RMSE:</b> ",
              round(
                rep_models$Refit_RMSE[i],
                3
              ),
              "<br>",


              "<b>RMSE improvement:</b> ",
              round(
                rep_models$Delta_RMSE[i],
                3
              ),
              "<br>",


              "<b>Refitted test MAE:</b> ",
              round(
                rep_models$Refit_MAE[i],
                3
              ),
              "<br><br>",


              "<b>Number of selected biomarkers:</b> ",
              rep_models$Number_predictors[i],
              "<br>",


              "<b>Selected biomarkers:</b> ",
              if (
                is.na(rep_models$Selected_biomarkers[i]) ||
                !nzchar(rep_models$Selected_biomarkers[i])
              ) {
                "None; the refit equals the baseline model"
              } else {
                escape_html(
                  rep_models$Selected_biomarkers[i]
                )
              },
              "<br><br>"

            )
          )


          ##################################################
          ############ Cross-validation plot ###############
          ##################################################

          cv_key <- paste(
            response_col,
            alpha_val,
            nfolds_val,
            this_seed,
            sep = "_"
          )


          cvfit <- cv_models[[cv_key]]


          if (!is.null(cvfit)) {

            cat(
              paste0(
                "<b>λmin:</b> ",
                signif(cvfit$lambda.min, 5),
                "<br>",

                "<b>λ1se:</b> ",
                signif(cvfit$lambda.1se, 5),
                "<br><br>\n\n"
              )
            )

            plot_representative_cv(cvfit)

            cat(
              paste0(
                "\n\n<p><small>",
                "The CV plot shows training cross-validation MSE. ",
                "The reported model uses λmin.",
                "</small></p>\n\n"
              )
            )

          } else {

            cat(
              "<b>Cross-validation plot not available.</b><br><br>"
            )
          }


          ##################################################
          ######## Refitted observed-versus-predicted #######
          ##################################################

          prediction_key <- paste(
            this_seed,
            response_col,
            alpha_val,
            nfolds_val,
            sep = "_"
          )


          prediction_info <-
            refit_prediction_storage[[prediction_key]]


          if (!is.null(prediction_info)) {

            valid_predictions <-
              is.finite(prediction_info$observed) &
              is.finite(prediction_info$predicted)


            if (any(valid_predictions)) {

              plot_data <- data.frame(
                Observed =
                  prediction_info$observed[valid_predictions],

                Predicted =
                  prediction_info$predicted[valid_predictions]
              )


              prediction_plot <-
                ggplot(
                  plot_data,

                  aes(
                    x = Observed,
                    y = Predicted
                  )
                ) +

                geom_point(
                  color = "#2166AC",
                  alpha = 0.75,
                  size = 2
                ) +

                geom_abline(
                  intercept = 0,
                  slope = 1,
                  linetype = "dashed",
                  color = "#B2182B",
                  linewidth = 0.8
                ) +

                coord_equal() +

                theme_minimal(
                  base_size = 12
                ) +

                labs(
                  title =
                    "Refitted linear regression: test predictions",

                  subtitle = paste0(
                    "Seed = ",
                    this_seed,
                    " | R² = ",
                    sprintf(
                      "%.3f",
                      prediction_info$r2
                    ),
                    " | RMSE = ",
                    sprintf(
                      "%.3f",
                      prediction_info$rmse
                    )
                  ),

                  x = "Observed outcome",

                  y = "Predicted outcome",

                  caption =
                    "Dashed line: perfect prediction."
                )


              print(prediction_plot)

              cat("\n\n")

            } else {

              cat(
                "<p>No finite test predictions are available.</p>"
              )
            }

          } else {

            cat(
              "<p>Refitted prediction plot not available.</p>"
            )
          }


          ##################################################
          ######## Elastic Net coefficient table ###########
          ##################################################

          elastic_table <-
            coefficients_df %>%

            filter(
              Seed == this_seed,
              Response == response_col,
              Alpha == alpha_val,
              nfolds == nfolds_val,

              # Include the intercept and all mandatory terms,
              # even when their estimated coefficients are zero.
              Variable == "(Intercept)" |
                Mandatory |
                Nonzero
            )


          elastic_file <- file.path(
            representative_directory,

            paste0(
              response_file_prefix,
              "_nfolds_",
              nfolds_val,
              "_alpha_",
              alpha_val,
              "_seed_",
              this_seed,
              "_ElasticNet.xlsx"
            )
          )


          write_xlsx(
            elastic_table,
            elastic_file
          )


          cat(
            paste0(
              '<a href="',
              escape_html(elastic_file),
              '" download>',
              'Download Elastic Net coefficients (Seed ',
              this_seed,
              ')</a><br><br>'
            )
          )


          print_representative_table(
            elastic_table,

            caption = paste(
              "Elastic Net coefficients",
              "(Seed",
              this_seed,
              ")"
            )
          )


          ##################################################
          ######## Refitted linear coefficient table #######
          ##################################################

          refit_table <-
            refit_coefficients %>%

            filter(
              Seed == this_seed,
              Response == response_col,
              Alpha == alpha_val,
              nfolds == nfolds_val
            )


          refit_file <- file.path(
            representative_directory,

            paste0(
              response_file_prefix,
              "_nfolds_",
              nfolds_val,
              "_alpha_",
              alpha_val,
              "_seed_",
              this_seed,
              "_Refitted.xlsx"
            )
          )


          if (nrow(refit_table) > 0) {

            # Export numeric coefficients and model performance.
            write_xlsx(
              list(
                Coefficients = refit_table,

                Performance =
                  as.data.frame(
                    rep_models[i, , drop = FALSE]
                  )
              ),

              path = refit_file
            )


            cat(
              paste0(
                '<a href="',
                escape_html(refit_file),
                '" download>',
                'Download Refitted Linear Model Results (Seed ',
                this_seed,
                ')</a><br><br>'
              )
            )


            refit_table_html <-
              refit_table %>%

              transmute(
                Predictor = term,

                Beta = estimate,

                SE = std.error,

                `t statistic` = statistic,

                `p-value` = ifelse(
                  is.finite(p.value),

                  format.pval(
                    p.value,
                    digits = 3,
                    eps = 0.001
                  ),

                  "—"
                ),

                FDR = ifelse(
                  is.finite(FDR),

                  format.pval(
                    FDR,
                    digits = 3,
                    eps = 0.001
                  ),

                  "—"
                )
              )


            print_representative_table(
              refit_table_html,

              caption = paste(
                "Refitted linear regression coefficients",
                "(Seed",
                this_seed,
                ")"
              )
            )


            cat(
              paste0(
                "<p><small>",
                "β is the adjusted association with the continuous ",
                "outcome; no odds ratios apply. ",
                "P-values and within-model FDR are exploratory ",
                "because the same training observations were used ",
                "for biomarker selection and OLS refitting.",
                "</small></p>"
              )
            )

          } else {

            cat(
              "<p>Refitted coefficient table not available.</p>"
            )
          }


          cat("<hr>")
        }
      }


      cat("</details><br>")
    }


    cat("</div></div></div><br>")
  }


  cat("</div></div></div><br>")
}




```
